title: Do Generative Priors Align with Human Naturalness Perception?
title_zh: 生成性先验是否与人类的自然性感知一致？

paragraphs.en: Visual generative models are trained to capture the probability distributions of natural images, yet whether their native priors reflect the regularities governing human perception of image naturalness remains an open question. Here, we probe these priors through native prediction errors across 25 open image and video generators. Because raw single-image losses are dominated by scene content and visual complexity, we evaluate directional loss differences using content-preserving, paired relational interventions that selectively disrupt facial configurations or physical illumination consistency while limiting changes in low-level image statistics. Across both domains, these loss differences reproduce human-like selective sensitivities and tolerances, capturing the classic Thatcher effect on faces and shape-dependent responses to illumination inconsistencies. Notably, these loss differences reliably track continuous gradations of human naturalness judgments across individual stimulus pairs (peaking at r = .84 r=.84 on faces and .64 .64 on physical scenes) and retain unique human-aligned signals even after controlling for feature distances from frozen vision encoders and standard image quality metrics. We also find that while overall sensitivity to these violations broadly covaries with human alignment across models, the two systematically decouple along denoising schedules, with alignment peaking earlier than sensitivity, revealing that human-like naturalness judgments dissociate from generic violation detection. Together, these findings demonstrate that learning visual distributions yields generative loss landscapes that capture distinct aspects of human naturalness perception.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉生成模型经过训练以捕捉自然图像的概率分布，但它们的内在先验是否反映了支配人类对图像自然性感知的规律，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。 在此，我们通过 25 个开放式的图像和视频生成器中的内在预测误差来探究这些先验。 由于原始单图像损失主要由场景内容和视觉复杂性主导，我们使用内容保留的成对关系干预法评估方向性损失差异：这些方法选择性地破坏面部结构或物理光照一致性，同时限制低层图像统计量的变化。 在两个领域内，这些损失差异再现了类人的选择性敏感性和容忍度，捕捉到了面部经典的“撒切尔效应”以及对光照不一致性的形状依赖响应。 值得注意的是，这些损失差异能够可靠地追踪单个刺激对之间人类自然性判断的连续梯度（在面部上达到 r = .84，在物理场景上达到 .64），并且在控制了来自冻结视觉编码器的特征距离和标准图像质量指标后，仍能保留与人类判断一致的独特信号。 我们还发现，尽管对这些违规性的整体敏感度在不同模型中与人类判断的一致性大致呈协变关系，但两者在去噪流程中会系统性地解耦：一致性比敏感度更早达到峰值，这表明类人的自然性判断与泛化的违规检测存在分离。 综合来看，这些发现表明，学习视觉分布能够产生生成性损失景观，从而捕捉到人类自然性感知的不同方面。

paragraphs.en: Human perception of image naturalness draws heavily on sensitivity to the statistical regularities of natural visual environments: cognitive theories formalize this as inference against internal distributional priors acquired through visual experience ( Yuille & Kersten, 2006 ) . Just as human vision relies on approximate statistical expectations rather than exact physical simulation, visual generative models produce strikingly realistic images from learned image distributions while frequently violating strict physical and geometric constraints ( Farid, 2022 ; Sarkar et al., 2024 ) . This parallel raises the possibility that generative priors, learned from visual distributions rather than explicit physical simulation, naturally capture the selective sensitivities and tolerances of human vision.
paragraphs.zh: 人类对图像自然性的感知在很大程度上依赖于对自然视觉环境中统计规律性的敏感程度：认知理论将这一过程形式化为基于通过视觉经验获得的内部分布先验进行推断（Yuille & Kersten, 2006）。 正如人类视觉依赖近似的统计预期而非精确的物理模拟一样，视觉生成模型也能从学习到的图像分布中生成极具真实感的图像，但常常违反严格的物理和几何约束（Farid, 2022；Sarkar et al., 2024）。 这种相似性表明，从视觉分布而非显式物理模拟中学习到的生成先验，或许能够自然地捕捉到人类视觉的选择性敏感性和容限。

paragraphs.en: Prior studies utilizing generative models for perceptual assessment have largely treated them as feature extractors, training supervised regressors on internal activations ( Fu et al., 2024 ; Raviv & Chechik, 2024 ) or engineering tuning-free attention-based metrics ( Song et al., 2025 ) . To test whether generative models naturally internalize human-aligned perceptual regularities without relying on such task-specific readouts, we turn directly to their native prediction objectives. In diffusion and flow architectures, denoising and velocity losses relate to score matching and variational bounds on data log-likelihood ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Kingma & Gao, 2023 ; Esser et al., 2024 ) , providing an empirical surrogate for negative log-likelihood that reflects an image’s plausibility under the learned distribution ( Clark & Jaini, 2023 ) . We therefore evaluate whether these native prediction errors directly track human naturalness ratings in a zero-shot manner, probing the perceptual sensitivities captured by native generative prediction objectives.
paragraphs.zh: 以往利用生成模型进行感知评估的研究，大多将其视为特征提取器，通过在内部激活值上训练有监督回归模型（Fu et al., 2024; Raviv & Chechik, 2024），或设计无需调参的注意力基指标（Song et al., 2025）来进行训练。 为了检验生成模型是否能在不依赖此类任务特定读出的情况下，自然地内化与人类感知一致的正则性，我们直接考察其固有的预测目标。 在扩散和流架构中，去噪损失和速度损失分别与分数匹配以及数据对数似然率的变分界相关（Ho et al., 2020; Kingma & Gao, 2023; Esser et al., 2024），这为负对数似然率提供了一个经验代理指标，反映了图像在所学分布下的合理性（Clark & Jaini, 2023）。 因此，我们评估这些固有的预测误差是否能够以零样本方式直接追踪人类对自然性的评分，从而探究原生生成预测目标所捕捉到的感知敏感性。

paragraphs.en: Evaluating native loss directly, however, faces a known obstacle: high-dimensional density estimates and unconditioned prediction errors are sensitive to low-level image complexity, background statistics, and data geometry, which can decouple density from perceived plausibility ( Nalisnick et al., 2019 ; Serrà et al., 2020 ; Ren et al., 2019 ; Kamkari et al., 2024 ) . Consistent with these concerns, in our control evaluation on a standard distortion benchmark (CSIQ ( Larson & Chandler, 2010 ) ), native prediction errors fail to track human quality judgments across distortion types, and removing visual elements like cast shadows can lower loss even though the scene becomes physically unnatural (Appendix F ). To separate relational plausibility from low-level statistical shifts, we adopt psychophysical paradigms based on content-preserving relational interventions ( Thompson, 1980 ; Ostrovsky et al., 2005 ; Nightingale et al., 2019 ) . Instead of adding or deleting objects, our manipulations alter spatial or physical configurations by reflecting existing image elements, which leaves coarse image statistics largely intact. The paired directional loss difference ( L modified − L original L_{\mathrm{modified}}-L_{\mathrm{original}} ) then controls for shared scene composition, focusing evaluation on whether the model penalizes the relational violations that reduce human-perceived naturalness.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，直接评估原生损失面临一个已知障碍：高维密度估计和无条件预测误差对低层图像复杂性、背景统计数据和数据几何结构非常敏感，这些因素可能导致密度与感知到的合理性脱节（Nalisnick 等，2019；Serrà 等，2020；Ren 等，2019；Kamkari 等，2024）。 与这些担忧一致，在我们对标准失真基准（CSIQ（Larson & Chandler，2010））进行的控制评估中，原生预测误差未能跨不同失真类型追踪人类的质量判断，并且移除诸如投射阴影之类的视觉元素甚至可能降低损失，尽管场景在物理上变得不自然（附录 F）。 为了将关系合理性从低层统计变化中分离出来，我们采用了基于内容保留的关系性干预的心理物理学范式（Thompson，1980；Ostrovsky 等，2005；Nightingale 等，2019）。 与添加或删除物体不同，我们的操作通过反射现有图像元素来改变空间或物理配置，从而在很大程度上保留了图像的粗略统计数据。 随后，成对的方向性损失差异（L_modified − L_original L_{\mathrm{modified}}-L_{\mathrm{original}}）控制了共享的场景构图，使评估能够专注于模型是否对降低人类感知自然度的关系性违规进行了惩罚。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate this approach across two controlled domains: the Thatcher face task (feature inversions in upright and inverted faces) and the Illumination task (shadow, reflection, and light-direction interventions in rendered scenes; Figure 1 ). In representative response profiles, paired generative loss differences capture characteristic human perceptual patterns, including the classic Thatcher effect and shape-dependent shadow sensitivities, while also revealing specific divergences (Figure 1 B). To test whether these correspondences reflect systematic perceptual alignment, we evaluate 25 open image and video generators on individual stimulus pairs, comparing native loss differences against human naturalness ratings, 12 frozen vision and multimodal encoders, and ten standard image quality metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两个受控领域中对这一方法进行了评估：撒切尔面孔任务（直立和倒置面孔的特征反转）以及光照任务（渲染场景中的阴影、反射和光线方向干预；图 1）。 在典型的响应分布中，成对生成损失的差异捕捉到了人类感知模式的特征，包括经典的撒切尔效应和依赖形状的阴影敏感度，同时也揭示了特定的差异（图 1B）。 为了检验这些对应关系是否反映了系统性的感知一致性，我们对 25 个开放图像和视频生成器进行了评估，针对单个刺激对，将原生损失差异与人类的自然度评分、12 个固定视觉和多模态编码器以及十项标准图像质量指标进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: Our investigation yields three primary findings. First, zero-shot directional loss differences reproduce human-like selective sensitivities and tolerances across representative physical and face conditions. Across individual items, these loss differences reliably track continuous human ratings (peaking at r = .84 r=.84 on faces and .64 .64 on physical scenes) and concentrate spatially within manipulated scene regions. Second, top generative models achieve higher human alignment than standard image quality metrics and frozen vision encoders, and retain non-redundant perceptual signals in bidirectional partial correlation analyses. Third, while coarse violation sensitivity broadly covaries with perceptual alignment across models, the two systematically decouple along denoising schedules, with alignment peaking earlier than sensitivity. Together, our work provides empirical evidence for a functional convergence between visual generative priors and human perception, showing that modern generative loss landscapes capture key aspects of the selective sensitivities and tolerances of human naturalness judgments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究得出了三个主要发现。 首先，零样本方向性损失差异在典型的物理场景和人脸条件下再现了类人的选择性敏感性和容限。 在各个具体项目中，这些损失差异能够可靠地追踪连续的人为评分（在人脸上的相关系数最高达到 r = .84，在物理场景上则为 .64），并且在被操控的场景区域内呈现出空间集中性。 其次，顶尖的生成模型在人类感知一致性方面优于标准的图像质量指标和冻结的视觉编码器，并且在双向部分相关性分析中保留了非冗余的感知信号。 第三，尽管粗略的违规敏感性与各模型中的感知一致性存在广泛的共变关系，但两者在去噪流程中会逐渐解耦，其中一致性会早于敏感性达到峰值。 综合来看，我们的研究为视觉生成先验与人类感知之间的功能性收敛提供了实证依据，表明现代生成模型的损失景观能够捕捉到人类自然性判断中的关键选择性敏感性和容限特征。

sents.en: Our investigation yields three primary findings.
sents.zh: 我们的研究得出了三个主要发现。

sents.en: Second, top generative models achieve higher human alignment than standard image quality metrics and frozen vision encoders, and retain non-redundant perceptual signals in bidirectional partial correlation analyses.
sents.zh: 其次，顶尖的生成模型在人类感知一致性方面优于标准的图像质量指标和冻结的视觉编码器，并且在双向部分相关性分析中保留了非冗余的感知信号。

sents.en: Third, while coarse violation sensitivity broadly covaries with perceptual alignment across models, the two systematically decouple along denoising schedules, with alignment peaking earlier than sensitivity.
sents.zh: 第三，尽管粗略的违规敏感性与各模型中的感知一致性存在广泛的共变关系，但两者在去噪流程中会逐渐解耦，其中一致性会早于敏感性达到峰值。

sents.en: Together, our work provides empirical evidence for a functional convergence between visual generative priors and human perception, showing that modern generative loss landscapes capture key aspects of the selective sensitivities and tolerances of human naturalness judgments.
sents.zh: 综合来看，我们的研究为视觉生成先验与人类感知之间的功能性收敛提供了实证依据，表明现代生成模型的损失景观能够捕捉到人类自然性判断中的关键选择性敏感性和容限特征。

paragraphs.en: Evaluating departures from natural image statistics is a long-standing approach in perceptual assessment. Classical no-reference image quality assessment (NR-IQA) measures distortions as deviations from parametric models of natural scene statistics ( Mittal et al., 2012 ; Mittal et al., 2013 ; Saad et al., 2012 ) . From a Bayesian perspective, visual quality assessment formalizes this principle as statistical inference against learned priors of natural visual environments ( Duanmu et al., 2021 ) , echoing cognitive theories of biological vision as Bayesian inference or inverse graphics ( Yuille & Kersten, 2006 ; Yildirim et al., 2020 ) . Modern deep generative models scale this principle by fitting high-dimensional distributions directly on large image corpora. However, raw density estimates and unconditioned prediction errors do not directly track perceptual quality. Likelihood-based deep models frequently assign higher likelihoods to out-of-distribution inputs than to in-distribution training data ( Nalisnick et al., 2019 ; Kirichenko et al., 2020 ) , reflecting sensitivity to input complexity ( Serrà et al., 2020 ) , background statistics ( Ren et al., 2019 ) , and manifold geometry ( Kamkari et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 评估对自然图像统计特性的偏离，一直是感知评估中沿用已久的一种方法。 经典的无参考图像质量评估（NR-IQA）将失真测量为对自然场景统计参数模型的偏离（Mittal 等，2012；Mittal 等，2013；Saad 等，2012）。 从贝叶斯视角来看，视觉质量评估将这一原则形式化为基于已学习的自然视觉环境先验进行统计推断（Duanmu 等，2021），这与将生物视觉视为贝叶斯推断或反向图形学的认知理论相呼应（Yuille & Kersten，2006；Yildirim 等，2020）。 现代深度生成模型通过直接在大型图像语料库上拟合高维分布，扩展了这一原则的应用规模。 然而，原始密度估计和无条件预测误差并不能直接反映感知质量。 基于似然的深度模型经常对分布外的输入赋予比分布内训练数据更高的似然值（Nalisnick 等，2019；Kirichenko 等，2020），这反映了模型对输入复杂性（Serrà 等，2020）、背景统计特性（Ren 等，2019）以及流形几何结构（Kamkari 等，2024）的敏感性。

paragraphs.en: To bypass these density confounds, recent approaches treat generative models as feature extractors, using supervised regressors on internal activations ( Fu et al., 2024 ; Raviv & Chechik, 2024 ) or tuning-free attention correspondences ( Song et al., 2025 ) . While effective for metric engineering, these feature-derived methods do not evaluate whether the model’s learned distribution itself aligns with human naturalness perception. Rather than engineering an applied IQA metric, our goal is a scientific inquiry: testing whether human perceptual priors are reflected directly within the native loss landscapes of generative models, using content-preserving relational interventions to probe prediction errors without intermediate readouts.
paragraphs.zh: 为了绕过这些密度相关的混淆因素，近期的方法将生成模型视为特征提取器，利用内部激活值上的监督回归模型（Fu et al., 2024; Raviv & Chechik, 2024）或无需调优的注意力对应关系（Song et al., 2025）。 尽管这些基于特征的方法在指标构建方面有效，但它们并未评估模型所学习的分布本身是否与人类的自然性感知一致。 我们的目标并非构建一个应用导向的 IQA 指标，而是进行一项科学探究：通过内容保留的关系性干预手段探测预测误差，而不依赖中间读取结果，从而检验人类感知先验是否直接反映在生成模型的原始损失景观中。

paragraphs.en: Several recent benchmarks evaluate whether generative models learn physical and causal regularities as predictive world models. While VideoPhy evaluates physical commonsense in video generation ( Bansal et al., 2025 ) and Physics-IQ tests real-world physical continuation ( Motamed et al., 2026 ) , LikePhys ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) and YoCausal ( Xie et al., 2026 ) use paired denoising-loss contrasts to test model preferences for physically valid or temporally plausible sequences, verifying their benchmarks against aggregate human model rankings. However, adherence to objective physical laws does not directly imply alignment with human perceptual naturalness. Psychophysical studies demonstrate that human observers frequently fail to detect or tolerate substantial physical inconsistencies in lighting, shadows, and reflections ( Mamassian, 2004 ; Ostrovsky et al., 2005 ; Cavanagh, 2005 ; Wilder et al., 2019 ; Nightingale et al., 2019 ) . A model that strictly penalizes all physical departures may therefore diverge from human naturalness judgments. Rather than evaluating whether models act as strict physical simulators, our Illumination task examines whether generative loss landscapes mirror the selective tolerances that characterize human perception, testing item-level correspondence with continuous human naturalness ratings under controlled physical interventions.
paragraphs.zh: 近期多项基准测试旨在评估生成模型是否将物理和因果规律内化为预测性世界模型。 虽然 VideoPhy 评估了视频生成中的物理常识（Bansal 等，2025），而 Physics-IQ 则测试了现实世界的物理延续性（Motamed 等，2026），LikePhys（Yuan 等，2026）和 YoCausal（Xie 等，2026）则通过成对的降噪损失对比，检验模型对物理有效或时间上合理的序列的偏好，并基于人类模型综合排名验证其基准测试。 然而，遵循客观物理定律并不直接意味着与人类的感知自然性保持一致。 心理物理学研究表明，人类观察者常常无法察觉或容忍光照、阴影和反射中的显著物理不一致性（Mamassian，2004；Ostrovsky 等，2005；Cavanagh，2005；Wilder 等，2019；Nightingale 等，2019）。 因此，一个严格惩罚所有物理偏差的模型可能会偏离人类对自然性的判断。 我们的 Illumination 任务并非评估模型是否充当严格的物理模拟器，而是探究生成损失景观是否反映了人类感知所具有的选择性容忍度，并在受控的物理干预下，检验其与连续的人类自然性评分在个体层级上的一致性。

paragraphs.en: Visual illusions and perceptual biases provide a classic benchmark for testing whether artificial neural networks reproduce biological visual phenomena ( Gómez-Villa et al., 2020 ; Jacob et al., 2021 ; Shahgir et al., 2024 ) . Prior computational studies have investigated these effects across several paradigms: convolutional filters adapt to natural statistics to reproduce low-level brightness illusions ( Gómez-Villa et al., 2020 ) , networks trained on edge-based image reconstruction replicate surface filling-in illusions ( Saha et al., 2026 ) , and diffusion models reveal human-like brightness shifts along their DDIM inversion trajectories ( Gómez-Villa et al., 2025 ) . In higher-level perception, configural phenomena such as the Thatcher illusion have been investigated in feedforward neural networks ( Jacob et al., 2021 ) , while structured inverse graphics models have captured other face-perception illusions such as the hollow-face effect ( Yildirim et al., 2020 ) . In addition, multimodal benchmarks probe illusions via linguistic question answering ( Shahgir et al., 2024 ) . Extending this line of inquiry, we test whether characteristic human perceptual biases are expressed directly within the native loss landscapes of visual generative models.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉错觉和感知偏差为检验人工神经网络能否再现生物视觉现象提供了一个经典基准（Gómez-Villa 等，2020；Jacob 等，2021；Shahgir 等，2024）。 先前的计算研究已在多种范式下探讨了这些效应：卷积滤波器通过适应自然统计特性来再现低层亮度错觉（Gómez-Villa 等，2020）；基于边缘图像重建训练的神经网络能够复现表面填充错觉（Saha 等，2026）；而扩散模型则揭示了其在 DDIM 反演轨迹上表现出类人亮度偏移的现象（Gómez-Villa 等，2025）。 在更高层的感知中，诸如 Thatcher 错觉之类的构型现象已在前馈神经网络中得到研究（Jacob 等，2021），而结构化逆图形模型则捕捉到了其他面部感知错觉，例如空心面效应（Yildirim 等，2020）。 此外，多模态基准测试通过语言问答来探究各种错觉（Shahgir 等，2024）。 为了进一步拓展这一研究思路，我们检验了人类典型的感知偏差是否直接体现在视觉生成模型的原生损失景观中。

paragraphs.en: Probing human naturalness perception across two domains. To investigate whether generative priors reflect human naturalness perception, we examine two distinct visual domains: face configurations and physical scene illumination. In face perception, observers exhibit pronounced orientation dependence: in the Thatcher illusion, inverted eyes and mouth appear grotesque in an upright face, but this distortion becomes difficult to detect when the entire face is inverted ( Thompson, 1980 ; de Haas & Schwarzkopf, 2018 ) . Testing Thatcherized faces evaluates whether generative models detect these localized feature inversions and whether their sensitivity exhibits orientation dependence. In physical scenes, observers can fail to detect substantial inconsistencies in illumination, shadows, and reflections ( Mamassian, 2004 ; Ostrovsky et al., 2005 ; Cavanagh, 2005 ; Wilder et al., 2019 ; Nightingale et al., 2019 ) . Testing illumination interventions determines whether models identify physical inconsistencies at all, and whether their responses reflect physical mechanics strictly or follow human perceptual tolerances and naturalness ratings.
paragraphs.zh: 探究人类在两个领域中对自然性的感知。 为了研究生成性先验是否反映了人类对自然性的感知，我们考察了两个不同的视觉领域：人脸构型与物理场景的照明。 在人脸感知中，观察者表现出明显的方向依赖性：在 Thatcher 错觉中，倒置的眼睛和嘴巴在直立的人脸上显得怪异，但当整张脸被倒置时，这种扭曲却难以察觉（Thompson, 1980；de Haas & Schwarzkopf, 2018）。 测试经过 Thatcher 处理的人脸，可以评估生成模型能否检测出这些局部特征倒置，以及其敏感度是否具有方向依赖性。 在物理场景中，观察者可能无法察觉照明、阴影和反射中的显著不一致性（Mamassian, 2004；Ostrovsky et al., 2005；Cavanagh, 2005；Wilder et al., 2019；Nightingale et al., 2019）。 测试对照明的干预，可以确定模型是否能够识别物理上的不一致性，以及其响应是严格遵循物理机制，还是反映了人类的感知容忍度和自然性评分。

paragraphs.en: Content-preserving relational interventions. To probe relational regularities while limiting low-level statistical shifts, we design two tasks using content-preserving relational interventions . Existing image content is rearranged while depicted objects remain in place, avoiding object deletion or insertion. This design largely preserves color distributions and edge content, reducing the density confounds observed in evaluation of raw native losses. The Thatcher task contains 140 public-domain face scenes from FFHQ ( Karras et al., 2019 ) , modified by in-place landmark-guided vertical reflection of the eye and mouth regions ( Alimohammadi, 2020 ) using dlib-based facial landmark detection ( King, 2009 ; Kazemi & Sullivan, 2014 ) and presented upright and inverted (280 original–modified pairs; Appendix A ). The Illumination task contains 96 scenes rendered in Kubric ( Greff et al., 2022 ) each for cast-shadow, reflection, and light-direction interventions (288 pairs): for shadow and reflection conditions, the rendered floor region was mirrored to exchange shadows or reflections while objects remained fixed; for the light-direction condition, the central object was horizontally mirrored while the flanking objects and floor, including any cast shadows, remained unchanged. To produce graded item difficulty, we varied object geometry, orientation or color, height, material, and lighting parameters across scenes (Appendix A ).
paragraphs.zh: 保留内容的相关性干预。 为了在限制低层统计变化的同时探测关系规律，我们设计了两个任务，采用保留内容的相关性干预方法。 现有图像内容被重新排列，但所描绘的物体仍保持原位，从而避免删除或添加物体。 这种设计在很大程度上保留了颜色分布和边缘内容，减少了在原始原生损失评估中观察到的密度干扰因素。 撒切尔任务包含来自 FFHQ（Karras 等，2019）的 140 个公共领域人脸场景，通过基于 dlib 的面部关键点检测（King，2009；Kazemi & Sullivan，2014），对眼睛和嘴巴区域进行原位关键点引导的垂直翻转进行修改（Alimohammadi，2020），并以正立和倒立形式呈现（280 对原始-修改图像；附录 A）。 照明任务包含在 Kubric（Greff 等，2022）中渲染的 96 个场景，每个场景分别用于投射阴影、反射和光照方向干预（共 288 对）：对于阴影和反射条件，渲染的地面区域被镜像以交换阴影或反射，而物体保持固定；对于光照方向条件，中心物体被水平镜像，而周围的物体和地面（包括任何投射的阴影）保持不变。 为了产生分级的项目难度，我们在不同场景中变化了物体的几何形状、朝向或颜色、高度、材质和光照参数（附录 A）。

sents.en: Content-preserving relational interventions.
sents.zh: 保留内容的相关性干预。

sents.en: To probe relational regularities while limiting low-level statistical shifts, we design two tasks using content-preserving relational interventions .
sents.zh: 为了在限制低层统计变化的同时探测关系规律，我们设计了两个任务，采用保留内容的相关性干预方法。

sents.en: This design largely preserves color distributions and edge content, reducing the density confounds observed in evaluation of raw native losses.

paragraphs.en: Human psychophysical experiments. Human observers rated the naturalness of each image on a 5-point scale (1: very unnatural to 5: natural ) in online psychophysical experiments. Each trial presented a single image (Figure 1 A). In the Thatcher task, each observer viewed upright and inverted faces from different identity sets, whereas illumination conditions were tested between subjects. In both tasks, original and modified versions of each scene were evaluated by the same observer across separate, randomized trials (Appendix B ). Following response-consistency screening (143 observers retained for Thatcher, 105 for Illumination), each item received an average of 35.8 ratings in Thatcher and 26.2 in Illumination. Item-mean ratings R ⁡ ( x ) R(x) define two measures: single-image unnaturalness a ⁡ ( x ) = 5 − R ⁡ ( x ) a(x)=5-R(x) and the paired unnaturalness effect h i = R ⁡ ( x i orig ) − R ⁡ ( x i mod ) h_{i}=R(x_{i}^{\mathrm{orig}})-R(x_{i}^{\mathrm{mod}}) , which quantifies the perceived unnaturalness introduced by each modification ( i i indexes stimulus pairs). Only item-level aggregates enter subsequent model analyses.
paragraphs.zh: 人类心理物理实验。 在在线心理物理实验中，人类观察者使用5分制量表（1：极不自然至5：自然）对每张图片的自然程度进行评分。 每次试验仅呈现一张图片（图1A）。 在 Thatcher 任务中，每位观察者分别观察来自不同身份集合的正立和倒置面孔，而光照条件则在不同受试者之间进行测试。 在这两项任务中，同一观察者通过独立且随机化的试验对每个场景的原始版本和修改版本进行了评估（附录B）。 经过反应一致性筛选后（Thatcher 任务保留143名观察者，Illumination 任务保留105名），每个项目在 Thatcher 任务中平均获得35.8次评分，在 Illumination 任务中平均获得26.2次评分。 项目均值评分 R(x) 定义了两个指标：单张图片的不自然程度 a(x)=5-R(x)，以及成对比较的不自然效应 h_{i}=R(x_{i}^{\mathrm{orig}})-R(x_{i}^{\mathrm{mod}})，后者量化了每次修改所引入的感知到的不自然程度（i 表示刺激对）。 只有项目层面的汇总数据会进入后续模型分析。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 25 open generative models (16 image, 9 video) across 11 families: (i) pixel-space image models ( JiT , PixelGen , HiDream-O1-Image ) ( Li & He, 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2026 ) ; (ii) latent-space image models ( Stable Diffusion v1.5/XL/3, FLUX.1/2, Qwen-Image ) ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Podell et al., 2024 ; Esser et al., 2024 ; Black Forest Labs, 2024 ; Black Forest Labs, 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) ; and (iii) spatiotemporal video models ( CogVideoX, LTX-Video, Wan2.1/2.2, HunyuanVideo ) ( Yang et al., 2025 ; HaCohen et al., 2024 ; Team Wan et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2024 ) . Static images are repeated as 17-frame clips, with 21 frames for CogVideoX1.5 to satisfy its temporal patching constraint. Text-conditioned models use the neutral or empty-prompt single-pass convention without classifier-free guidance; a control evaluation on a text-conditioned subset confirms that adding descriptive prompts does not alter our findings (Appendix O ). Model checkpoints, schedules, and evaluation details appear in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了 25 个开放生成模型（16 个图像模型、9 个视频模型），涵盖 11 个系列：(i) 像素空间图像模型（JiT、PixelGen、HiDream-O1-Image）（Li & He, 2026；Ma et al., 2026；Cai et al., 2026）；(ii) 潜在空间图像模型（Stable Diffusion v1.5/XL/3、FLUX.1/2、Qwen-Image）（Rombach et al., 2022；Podell et al., 2024；Esser et al., 2024；Black Forest Labs, 2024；Black Forest Labs, 2025；Wu et al., 2025）；以及 (iii) 时空视频模型（CogVideoX、LTX-Video、Wan2.1/2.2、HunyuanVideo）（Yang et al., 2025；HaCohen et al., 2024；Team Wan et al., 2025；Kong et al., 2024）。 静态图像被重复用作 17 帧的片段，而 CogVideoX1.5 则使用 21 帧以满足其时间分块约束。 文本条件模型采用中性或空提示的单次处理惯例，且不使用无分类器引导；对文本条件子集的控制性评估证实，添加描述性提示并不会改变我们的研究结果（附录 O）。 模型检查点、调度方案及评估细节见附录 C。

paragraphs.en: Standardized unnaturalness and condition profiles (Section 4.1 ). Because raw loss scales differ across models and share no common units with human perceptual ratings, raw paired differences ( u m , i = L m ​ ( x i mod ) − L m ​ ( x i orig ) u_{m,i}=L_{m}(x_{i}^{\mathrm{mod}})-L_{m}(x_{i}^{\mathrm{orig}}) for models, h i h_{i} for humans) cannot be directly compared across models or against human judgments. To place models and human ratings on a common scale for condition- and factor-level comparisons, we define the standardized unnaturalness score for each stimulus pair i i as the paired difference divided by the task-wide sample standard deviation: u ~ m , i = u m , i / s m , task \tilde{u}_{m,i}=u_{m,i}/s_{m,\mathrm{task}} and h ~ i = h i / s h , task \tilde{h}_{i}=h_{i}/s_{h,\mathrm{task}} , where s m , task s_{m,\mathrm{task}} and s h , task s_{h,\mathrm{task}} are computed across all N N pairs within the task ( N = 280 N=280 for Thatcher, N = 288 N=288 for Illumination, using N − 1 N-1 degrees of freedom). Averaging u ~ m , i \tilde{u}_{m,i} across specific stimulus factor levels yields the paired response profiles that probe selective sensitivities and tolerances (e.g., face orientation, object geometry, or lighting shifts; Figure 1 B). Human sensitivity profiles are defined analogously from h ~ i \tilde{h}_{i} . To examine where loss penalties arise, we compute pixel-level paired prediction error maps (Figure 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 标准化非自然性与条件配置文件（第 4.1 节）。 由于原始损失尺度在不同模型间存在差异，且与人类感知评分没有共同单位，因此模型间的原始配对差异（u_{m,i}=L_{m}(x_{i}^{\mathrm{mod}})-L_{m}(x_{i}^{\mathrm{orig}})，人类则为 h_{i}）无法在不同模型之间直接比较，也无法与人类判断进行比较。 为了将模型和人类评分置于同一尺度上，以便进行条件和因素层面的比较，我们将每个刺激对 i 的标准化非自然性得分定义为配对差异除以整个任务中的样本标准差：\tilde{u}_{m,i}=u_{m,i}/s_{m,\mathrm{task}} 和 \tilde{h}_{i}=h_{i}/s_{h,\mathrm{task}}，其中 s_{m,\mathrm{task}} 和 s_{h,\mathrm{task}} 是在任务内的所有 N 个配对中计算的（Thatcher 任务中 N=280，Illumination 任务中 N=288，使用 N-1 个自由度）。 对特定刺激因素水平下的 \tilde{u}_{m,i} 求平均，可得到用于探测选择性与敏感性及耐受性的配对响应配置文件（例如，面部朝向、物体几何形状或光照变化；图 1B）。 人类敏感性配置文件以类似方式从 \tilde{h}_{i} 中定义。 为了探究损失惩罚产生的位置，我们计算像素级别的配对预测误差图（图 2）。

sents.en: Standardized unnaturalness and condition profiles (Section 4.1 ).
sents.zh: 标准化非自然性与条件配置文件（第 4.1 节）。

sents.en: Because raw loss scales differ across models and share no common units with human perceptual ratings, raw paired differences ( u m , i = L m ​ ( x i mod ) − L m ​ ( x i orig ) u_{m,i}=L_{m}(x_{i}^{\mathrm{mod}})-L_{m}(x_{i}^{\mathrm{orig}}) for models, h i h_{i} for humans) cannot be directly compared across models or against human judgments.
sents.zh: 由于原始损失尺度在不同模型间存在差异，且与人类感知评分没有共同单位，因此模型间的原始配对差异（u_{m,i}=L_{m}(x_{i}^{\mathrm{mod}})-L_{m}(x_{i}^{\mathrm{orig}})，人类则为 h_{i}）无法在不同模型之间直接比较，也无法与人类判断进行比较。

sents.en: To place models and human ratings on a common scale for condition- and factor-level comparisons, we define the standardized unnaturalness score for each stimulus pair i i as the paired difference divided by the task-wide sample standard deviation: u ~ m , i = u m , i / s m , task \tilde{u}_{m,i}=u_{m,i}/s_{m,\mathrm{task}} and h ~ i = h i / s h , task \tilde{h}_{i}=h_{i}/s_{h,\mathrm{task}} , where s m , task s_{m,\mathrm{task}} and s h , task s_{h,\mathrm{task}} are computed across all N N pairs within the task ( N = 280 N=280 for Thatcher, N = 288 N=288 for Illumination, using N − 1 N-1 degrees of freedom).
sents.zh: 为了将模型和人类评分置于同一尺度上，以便进行条件和因素层面的比较，我们将每个刺激对 i 的标准化非自然性得分定义为配对差异除以整个任务中的样本标准差：\tilde{u}_{m,i}=u_{m,i}/s_{m,\mathrm{task}} 和 \tilde{h}_{i}=h_{i}/s_{h,\mathrm{task}}，其中 s_{m,\mathrm{task}} 和 s_{h,\mathrm{task}} 是在任务内的所有 N 个配对中计算的（Thatcher 任务中 N=280，Illumination 任务中 N=288，使用 N-1 个自由度）。

sents.en: Averaging u ~ m , i \tilde{u}_{m,i} across specific stimulus factor levels yields the paired response profiles that probe selective sensitivities and tolerances (e.g., face orientation, object geometry, or lighting shifts; Figure 1 B).
sents.zh: 对特定刺激因素水平下的 \tilde{u}_{m,i} 求平均，可得到用于探测选择性与敏感性及耐受性的配对响应配置文件（例如，面部朝向、物体几何形状或光照变化；图 1B）。

sents.en: Human sensitivity profiles are defined analogously from h ~ i \tilde{h}_{i} .
sents.zh: 人类敏感性配置文件以类似方式从 \tilde{h}_{i} 中定义。

sents.en: To examine where loss penalties arise, we compute pixel-level paired prediction error maps (Figure 2 ).
sents.zh: 为了探究损失惩罚产生的位置，我们计算像素级别的配对预测误差图（图 2）。

paragraphs.en: Item-level human alignment (Section 4.2 ). To determine whether this perceptual correspondence generalizes beyond condition-level averages to continuous scene-by-scene judgments, human alignment measures whether graded model penalties track continuous human naturalness ratings across individual items, quantified by the item-level Pearson correlation r m = corr i ⁡ ( u m , i , h i ) r_{m}=\operatorname{corr}_{i}(u_{m,i},h_{i}) within each task. Furthermore, to test whether this correspondence reflects unique perceptual structure beyond standard visual features, we evaluate generative models alongside standard quality metrics and frozen vision encoders, using bidirectional partial correlations to isolate non-redundant signals (Section 3.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 项目级人类对齐（第 4.2 节）。 为了判断这种感知对应关系是否超越了条件级的平均值，能够推广到连续的场景间判断中，人类对齐衡量了模型的分等级惩罚是否在单个项目上持续跟踪人类的自然度评分，其量化指标为每个任务中的项目级皮尔逊相关系数 r m = corr i ⁡ ( u m , i , h i ) r_{m}=\operatorname{corr}_{i}(u_{m,i},h_{i})。 此外，为了检验这种对应关系是否反映了超越标准视觉特征的独特感知结构，我们将生成模型与标准质量指标和冻结的视觉编码器一同进行评估，并利用双向部分相关来分离非冗余信号（第 3.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: Coupling and dissociation of sensitivity and alignment (Section 4.3 ). Finally, to test whether violation detection and perceptual naturalness represent unified or dissociable properties, we contrast human alignment against coarse violation sensitivity . Task-level sensitivity S m S_{m} is defined as the mean standardized score across all pairs in the task ( S m = N − 1 ​ ∑ i u ~ m , i S_{m}=N^{-1}\sum_{i}\tilde{u}_{m,i} ), and condition-level sensitivity S m , c S_{m,c} averages over the pairs I c I_{c} within condition c c ( S m , c = | I c | − 1 ​ ∑ i ∈ I c u ~ m , i S_{m,c}=|I_{c}|^{-1}\sum_{i\in I_{c}}\tilde{u}_{m,i} ). We then evaluate how this coarse violation sensitivity relates to fine-grained human alignment across model architectures and along denoising schedules.

paragraphs.en: Uncertainty estimation. Confidence intervals for human-dependent estimates use 10,000 participant-and-scene bootstrap resamples, whereas those for generative-model sensitivities use scene resampling alone. For cross-model sensitivity–alignment correlations, we additionally perform cluster bootstrap resampling over model families (Appendix E ). To verify that associations between sensitivity and alignment are not driven by shared Monte Carlo sampling error, we estimated the two metrics from independent noise draws and observed closely matching results (Appendix P ).
paragraphs.zh: 不确定性估计。 对人类依赖的估计值，其置信区间使用包含 10,000 个参与者与场景的自助重采样；而对于生成模型敏感性的置信区间，则仅对场景进行重采样。 对于跨模型敏感性与对齐的相关性分析，我们额外在模型族上执行了聚类自助重采样（附录 E）。 为了验证敏感性与对齐之间的关联并非由共享的蒙特卡洛采样误差所驱动，我们从独立的噪声样本中估计了这两个指标，并观察到结果高度一致（附录 P）。

paragraphs.en: We compare generative scores with a prespecified pool of 12 frozen image encoders (24M–8.1B parameters) and two five-metric IQA batteries (Appendix D ). The encoder panel includes ResNet-50 ( He et al., 2016 ) , CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , DINOv2/v3 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ; Siméoni et al., 2026 ) , SigLIP 2 ( Tschannen et al., 2025 ) , PE-Core ( Bolya et al., 2025 ) , Qwen3-VL-Embedding ( Li et al., 2026 ) , and Jina CLIP v2 ( Koukounas et al., 2024 ) . Encoder scores use cosine distances between global vectors, or the mean distance between corresponding spatial patches for DINOv2/v3, capturing representational divergence across paired images. We evaluate representations across all intermediate blocks alongside each model’s default final output, extracting features via fixed architecture-specific pooling (Appendix D ). For each encoder and task, we select the candidate with the highest Pearson correlation with human judgments. While this post-hoc layer selection deliberately favors the encoder baselines over zero-shot generative scores, fixed feature distances measure the magnitude of change rather than the direction of degradation. Thus, they serve as a diagnostic baseline rather than an upper bound on encoder representations. The IQA batteries comprise FR-IQA (PSNR, SSIM, VIF, LPIPS, DISTS; Wang et al., 2004 ; Sheikh & Bovik, 2006 ; Zhang et al., 2018 ; Ding et al., 2022 ) and NR-IQA (NIQE, BRISQUE, HyperIQA, MUSIQ, LIQE; Mittal et al., 2013 ; Mittal et al., 2012 ; Su et al., 2020 ; Ke et al., 2021 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们将生成分数与一个预定义的 12 个冻结图像编码器（参数规模从 24M 到 8.1B）以及两套包含五个指标的质量评估电池（附录 D）进行比较。 编码器列表包括 ResNet-50（He 等，2016）、CLIP（Radford 等，2021）、DINOv2/v3（Oquab 等，2024；Siméoni 等，2026）、SigLIP 2（Tschannen 等，2025）、PE-Core（Bolya 等，2025）、Qwen3-VL-Embedding（Li 等，2026）以及 Jina CLIP v2（Koukounas 等，2024）。 编码器分数使用全局向量之间的余弦距离，或对于 DINOv2/v3 则使用对应空间块之间的平均距离，以捕捉配对图像之间表征的差异。 我们在所有中间层以及每个模型默认的最终输出上评估其表征，并通过固定的架构特定池化方法提取特征（附录 D）。 对于每个编码器和任务，我们选择与人类判断具有最高皮尔逊相关性的候选方案。 尽管这种事后层的选择策略有意偏向编码器基线模型而非零样本生成分数，但固定的特征距离衡量的是变化的幅度，而非退化的方向。 因此，它们仅作为诊断性基线，而非编码器表征的上限。 这些质量评估电池包括 FR-IQA（PSNR、SSIM、VIF、LPIPS、DISTS；Wang 等，2004；Sheikh & Bovik，2006；Zhang 等，2018；Ding 等，2022）和 NR-IQA（NIQE、BRISQUE、HyperIQA、MUSIQ、LIQE；Mittal 等，2013；Mittal 等，2012；Su 等，2020；Ke 等，2021；Zhang 等，2023）。

paragraphs.en: To test whether generative loss differences capture human-aligned naturalness judgments that provide non-redundant information relative to standard image quality metrics and high-level visual encoders, we evaluate human alignment and bidirectional partial correlations against top-performing baselines. After selecting each encoder’s best-performing layer, we assess human alignment across candidate models, retaining the top five Generative models and top five Encoders alongside all five metrics from each prespecified IQA battery. For every selected generative–encoder pair ( G , X ) (G,X) , we compute r ⁡ ( h , G ∣ X ) r(h,G\mid X) and r ⁡ ( h , X ∣ G ) r(h,X\mid G) , summarizing each 5 × 5 5\times 5 comparison by its medians. Top-five models are selected over each entire task and retained, together with the selected encoder layers, across its conditions (Appendix I ). To account for selection uncertainty, confidence intervals are estimated via 10,000 participant-and-scene bootstrap resamples, repeating layer selection followed by model selection within each draw (Appendix E.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验生成性损失差异是否能够捕捉到与人类感知一致的自然度判断，而这些判断相较于标准的图像质量指标和高层视觉编码器提供了非冗余信息，我们对人类对齐度和双向部分相关性进行了评估，并与表现最佳的基线模型进行了对比。 在选定每个编码器的最佳性能层之后，我们评估了候选模型中的人类对齐度，保留了排名前五的生成模型和前五的编码器，以及每个预定义图像质量评估（IQA）电池中的全部五个指标。 对于每一对选定的生成模型–编码器组合（G, X），我们计算了 r(h, G∣X) 和 r(h, X∣G)，并通过其中位数对每个 5×5 的比较进行了总结。 在所有任务中，排名前五的模型均被选中并保留下来，连同所选的编码器层一起，适用于该任务的所有条件（附录 I）。 为了考虑选择过程中的不确定性，我们通过 10,000 次参与者和场景的自助重采样估计了置信区间，并在每次抽样中重复进行层选择和模型选择（附录 E.3）。

paragraphs.en: We first examined standardized unnaturalness profiles across representative stimulus manipulations (Figure 1 B). In the Thatcher task, humans and top generative models strongly penalized upright facial feature inversions, with sensitivity dropping sharply under inversion (Figure 1 B; top-five generative median: 2.44 2.44 upright vs. 0.91 0.91 inverted; across all 25 models, median sensitivity was 2.24 2.24 vs. 0.84 0.84 ; humans: 2.73 2.73 vs. 1.09 1.09 ; Appendix G ). In the Illumination task, generative model losses tracked human unnaturalness across scene geometry: for cast shadows, both humans and models showed pronounced sensitivity to shadow rotations for objects with distinctive directional landmarks (e.g., teapot), but remained tolerant for shapes lacking prominent in-plane asymmetries (e.g., Spot; Figure 1 B). Crucially, top vision encoders failed to capture this selective sensitivity, showing uniformly low responses across both objects ( 0.28 0.28 vs. 0.27 0.27 ), and similarly missed human sensitivity to light-direction changes on simple spheres (Figure 1 B). Conversely, human and model responses diverged on reflection color: whereas humans strongly penalized subtle hue mismatches, generative models showed relatively weak sensitivity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先考察了在不同代表性刺激操控条件下标准化的非自然性特征（图 1B）。 在 Thatcher 任务中，人类和顶尖生成模型对直立面部特征的倒置表现出强烈的惩罚效应，而在倒置条件下敏感性急剧下降（图 1B；前五大生成模型的中间值：直立时为 2.44 2.44，倒置时为 0.91 0.91；在所有 25 个模型中，敏感性的中间值为 2.24 2.24 对比 0.84 0.84；人类为 2.73 2.73 对比 1.09 1.09；附录 G）。 在 Illumination 任务中，生成模型的损失值与人类对场景几何结构的非自然性感知保持一致：对于投射阴影，人类和模型都对具有明显方向性特征（例如茶壶）的物体上的阴影旋转表现出显著的敏感性，但对于缺乏显著平面内不对称性的形状（例如 Spot）则保持容忍（图 1B）。 关键的是，顶尖视觉编码器未能捕捉到这种选择性的敏感性，对两种物体的响应均普遍较低（0.28 0.28 对比 0.27 0.27），并且同样未能识别出人类对简单球体上光方向变化的敏感性（图 1B）。 相反，在反射颜色方面，人类和模型的响应出现了分歧：人类对细微的色调不匹配表现出强烈的惩罚效应，而生成模型则显示出相对较弱的敏感性。

paragraphs.en: Spatial loss-difference maps reveal where violation penalties arise across the scene (Figure 2 ). For upright Thatcher faces, loss increases concentrated around the inverted eyes and mouth, with marked attenuation under face inversion. For illumination interventions, loss increases were not confined to manipulated regions, extending from floor surfaces to objects directly above altered shadows or reflections, and from the central object to unmodified flanking objects under light-direction shifts. These maps indicate that generative models evaluate contextual relationships across the scene rather than isolated local modifications.
paragraphs.zh: 空间损失差异图揭示了场景中违规惩罚出现的位置（图2）。 对于正立的撒切尔人脸，损失增加主要集中在倒置的眼睛和嘴巴周围，而在人脸倒置时则明显减弱。 对于光照干预，损失增加并未局限于被操控的区域，而是从地板表面延伸至被改变阴影或反射直接上方的物体，以及从中心物体延伸至光照方向变化下未受影响的相邻物体。 这些地图表明，生成模型评估的是整个场景中的上下文关系，而非孤立的局部修改。

paragraphs.en: Item-level agreement across generative models. We next tested whether these selective sensitivities generalize to continuous, item-level agreement across the full 25-model benchmark. Across individual stimulus pairs, directional loss changes ( u m , i = L m ​ ( x i mod ) − L m ​ ( x i orig ) u_{m,i}=L_{m}(x_{i}^{\mathrm{mod}})-L_{m}(x_{i}^{\mathrm{orig}}) ) reliably tracked continuous human unnaturalness ratings ( h i h_{i} ), with median Pearson correlations of .747 .747 on Thatcher (peaking at .841 .841 ) and .334 .334 on Illumination (peaking at .639 .639 ; Figure 3 A). This alignment was not driven merely by coarse mean differences across conditions: after condition centering (subtracting condition-specific means from both model losses and human ratings to isolate item-level rankings within each condition), correlations remained positive for all 25 models on both tasks (medians of .411 .411 and .271 .271 ; peaking at .534 .534 and .619 .619 ; condition breakdowns in Appendix H ). In sharp contrast, unconditioned single-image losses ( L m ​ ( x ) L_{m}(x) ) showed little correlation with human ratings (25-model medians of − .20 -.20 to .24 .24 ; Appendix F.2 ), confirming that paired differencing is essential to separate relational naturalness from shared scene composition.
paragraphs.zh: 生成模型之间的项目级一致性。 接下来，我们检验了这些选择性敏感度是否可扩展到整个包含25个模型的基准测试中，实现连续的项目级一致性。 在各个刺激对层面，方向性损失变化（ u m , i = L m ​ ( x i mod ) − L m ​ ( x i orig ) u_{m,i}=L_{m}(x_{i}^{\mathrm{mod}})-L_{m}(x_{i}^{\mathrm{orig}}) ）能够稳定地追踪人类对不自然程度的连续评分（ h i h_{i} ），在Thatcher任务中，皮尔逊相关系数的中位数为 .747（最高达 .841），在Illumination任务中为 .334（最高达 .639；见图3A）。 这种一致性并非单纯由不同条件下的粗略均值差异所驱动：在对条件进行中心化处理后（即从模型损失和人类评分中减去各条件特定的均值，以分离出每个条件下的项目级排名），所有25个模型在这两项任务中的相关性仍保持正值（中位数分别为 .411 和 .271；最高值分别为 .534 和 .619；条件分解见附录H）。 相比之下，未经条件化的单图像损失（ L m ​ ( x ) L_{m}(x) ）与人类评分的相关性极弱（25个模型的中位数在 − .20 至 .24 之间；见附录F.2），这证实了配对差异法对于区分关系性自然度与共享场景构图至关重要。

paragraphs.en: Notably, human alignment was observed across diverse generative formulations (diffusion versus flow), modeling spaces (pixel versus latent), and modalities (image versus video), with substantial within-category variation (model-wise breakdowns across conditions in Figure S12 ; model specifications in Table S1 ). Furthermore, high alignment emerged in models whose training recipes include no explicit preference optimization (e.g., RLHF or DPO). On Thatcher, class-conditional JiT models ( Li & He, 2026 ) trained solely on ImageNet exhibited alignment that scaled systematically with model capacity (reaching r = .577 r=.577 for JiT-H/32), alongside strong agreement in SD v1.5 ( r = .825 r=.825 ). On Illumination, Wan2.1 14B ( Team Wan et al., 2025 ) achieved the highest overall correlation ( r = .639 r=.639 , remaining .619 .619 after condition centering), with solid alignment also sustained in video models such as CogVideoX ( Yang et al., 2025 ) . These findings indicate that perceptual alignment with human naturalness judgments emerges directly from learning visual data distributions.
paragraphs.zh: 值得注意的是，在多种生成方法（扩散模型与流模型）、建模空间（像素空间与潜在空间）以及模态（图像与视频）中均观察到了人类对齐现象，但同一类别内部也存在显著差异（图 S12 中各条件下不同模型的详细分析；表 S1 中的模型规格）。 此外，在训练流程中未包含任何显式偏好优化（例如 RLHF 或 DPO）的模型中也出现了高度对齐。 在 Thatcher 数据集上，仅基于 ImageNet 训练的类条件 JiT 模型（Li & He, 2026）表现出随模型容量系统性增强的对齐能力（JiT-H/32 的 r 值达到 .577），同时在 SD v1.5 中也展现出强一致性（r = .825）。 在 Illumination 数据集上，Wan2.1 14B（Team Wan et al., 2025）实现了最高的整体相关性（r = .639，条件中心化后仍为 .619），且视频模型如 CogVideoX（Yang et al., 2025）也保持了良好的对齐能力。 这些发现表明，与人类自然性判断的感知对齐直接源于对视觉数据分布的学习。

paragraphs.en: Comparison with visual encoder and IQA baselines. Across both tasks, top generative models achieved higher human alignment than all evaluated baselines (Figure 3 A), even after selecting each encoder’s best-performing layer (top-five median r = .816 r=.816 vs. .660 .660 on Thatcher; .602 .602 vs. .492 .492 on Illumination). In contrast, standard image quality metrics showed substantially weaker correspondence: NR-IQA correlations remained near zero throughout ( .087 .087 on Thatcher, .009 .009 on Illumination), arguing against generic degradation or manipulation artifacts, while weak FR-IQA results ( .103 .103 and .254 .254 ) indicate that alignment is not driven merely by low-level change magnitude.
paragraphs.zh: 与视觉编码器和 IQA 基线方法的比较。 在两项任务中，顶尖生成模型都实现了比所有评估基线方法更高的人类对齐度（图 3A），即使在选择了每个编码器表现最佳的层之后也是如此（Thatcher 数据集上，前五层的中位数 r = .816 vs. .660；Illumination 数据集上，r = .602 vs. .492）。 相比之下，标准图像质量指标表现出明显较弱的对应关系：NR-IQA 的相关性始终接近于零（Thatcher 数据集上为 .087，Illumination 数据集上为 .009），这表明问题并非由通用的图像退化或篡改伪影引起；而较弱的 FR-IQA 结果（.103 和 .254）则表明，对齐度并非仅仅由低层变化的幅度所驱动。

paragraphs.en: Bidirectional partial correlations with baselines. Generative scores also retained robust positive residual associations after controlling for baseline metrics in bidirectional partial correlation analyses (Figure 3 B). Controlling for standard IQA metrics had little effect on generative alignment (medians of r ⁡ ( h , G ∣ IQA ) = .809 r(h,G\mid\mathrm{IQA})=.809 – .825 .825 on Thatcher and .535 .535 – .602 .602 on Illumination), while IQA residual associations remained near or below zero ( − .160 -.160 to .106 .106 ), confirming that generative signals do not simply reflect low-level degradation or distortion magnitude. When evaluated alongside frozen vision encoders, generative scores likewise preserved positive residual associations. On Thatcher, generative scores retained strong incremental explanatory power (median partial correlation of .676 .676 , 95% CI [ .612 , .701 ] [.612,.701] vs. .130 .130 , [ .054 , .228 ] [.054,.228] for encoders), whereas on Illumination, both representations retained substantial non-redundant associations ( .510 .510 for generative models vs. .375 .375 for encoders), demonstrating complementary perceptual structure. Broken down by condition, generative scores contributed distinct variance for upright faces, cast shadows, and light direction, while encoders retained larger associations for surface reflections (Figure S14 , Appendix I ). Together, these results indicate that native generative loss landscapes capture human-aligned perceptual regularities that are distinct from standard quality metrics and complementary to discriminative visual encoders.
paragraphs.zh: 与基线相关的双向部分相关性。 在双向部分相关性分析中，即使控制了基线指标，生成性评分仍保持了稳健的积极残差关联（图3B）。 控制标准IQA指标对生成性对齐的影响微乎其微（Thatcher数据集上r(h,G∣IQA)的中位数为0.809–0.825，Illumination数据集上为0.535–0.602），而IQA的残差关联则接近或低于零（−0.160至0.106），这证实了生成性信号并非简单地反映低层退化或失真程度。 在与冻结视觉编码器一同评估时，生成性评分同样保持了积极的残差关联。 在Thatcher数据集上，生成性评分保留了强大的增量解释力（部分相关性的中位数为0.676，95%置信区间为[0.612, 0.701]，而编码器的中位数为0.130，置信区间为[0.054, 0.228]）；而在Illumination数据集上，两种表示均保留了显著的冗余性关联（生成模型为0.510，编码器为0.375），表明它们具有互补的感知结构。 按条件细分，生成性评分对直立面孔、投射阴影和光照方向贡献了独特的方差，而编码器则对表面反射保持了更强的关联（图S14，附录I）。 综合来看，这些结果表明，原生生成性损失景观能够捕捉到与人类感知对齐的规律性特征，这些特征既不同于标准质量指标，也与判别性视觉编码器形成互补。

sents.en: On Thatcher, generative scores retained strong incremental explanatory power (median partial correlation of .676 .676 , 95% CI [ .612 , .701 ] [.612,.701] vs. .130 .130 , [ .054 , .228 ] [.054,.228] for encoders), whereas on Illumination, both representations retained substantial non-redundant associations ( .510 .510 for generative models vs. .375 .375 for encoders), demonstrating complementary perceptual structure.
sents.zh: 在Thatcher数据集上，生成性评分保留了强大的增量解释力（部分相关性的中位数为0.676，95%置信区间为[0.612, 0.701]，而编码器的中位数为0.130，置信区间为[0.054, 0.228]）；而在Illumination数据集上，两种表示均保留了显著的冗余性关联（生成模型为0.510，编码器为0.375），表明它们具有互补的感知结构。

sents.en: Broken down by condition, generative scores contributed distinct variance for upright faces, cast shadows, and light direction, while encoders retained larger associations for surface reflections (Figure S14 , Appendix I ).
sents.zh: 按条件细分，生成性评分对直立面孔、投射阴影和光照方向贡献了独特的方差，而编码器则对表面反射保持了更强的关联（图S14，附录I）。

sents.en: Together, these results indicate that native generative loss landscapes capture human-aligned perceptual regularities that are distinct from standard quality metrics and complementary to discriminative visual encoders.
sents.zh: 综合来看，这些结果表明，原生生成性损失景观能够捕捉到与人类感知对齐的规律性特征，这些特征既不同于标准质量指标，也与判别性视觉编码器形成互补。

paragraphs.en: Cross-model association. To test whether human alignment simply reflects stronger violation detection, we examined whether models with greater violation sensitivity also showed closer human alignment, evaluating this relationship both across each task as a whole and within individual stimulus conditions (Figure 4 ). Across the full benchmark, violation sensitivity exhibited an overall positive association with item-level human alignment (Figure 4 A; Thatcher: r = .663 r=.663 , 95% CI [ .086 , .905 ] [.086,.905] ; Illumination: r = .821 r=.821 , [ .542 , .922 ] [.542,.922] ), with larger models generally clustering toward the upper right (Appendix K , Figure S19 ). Within individual conditions (Figure 4 B), positive associations were robust for cast shadows ( r = .810 r=.810 , 95% CI [ .424 , .960 ] [.424,.960] ) and inverted faces ( r = .723 r=.723 , [ .118 , .923 ] [.118,.923] ). For upright faces, the point estimate remained positive but carried wide estimation uncertainty ( r = .667 r=.667 , [ − .215 , .904 ] [-.215,.904] ), whereas associations were near zero for light direction ( r = .051 r=.051 , [ − .417 , .570 ] [-.417,.570] ) and negative for surface reflections ( r = − .371 r=-.371 , [ − .704 , .364 ] [-.704,.364] ; Appendix H ). Thus, while sensitivity and alignment covary across each task as a whole, this coupling is not uniform across individual stimulus conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 跨模型关联。 为了检验人类对齐是否仅仅反映了更强的违规检测能力，我们研究了是否具有更高违规敏感性的模型是否也表现出更贴近人类的对齐，并从整体任务层面和单个刺激条件层面评估了这种关系（图4）。 在整个基准测试中，违规敏感性与项目层面的人类对齐总体上呈现正相关（图4A；Thatcher：r = .663 r=.663，95% CI [ .086 , .905 ] [.086,.905]；Illumination：r = .821 r=.821，[ .542 , .922 ] [.542,.922]），其中较大模型通常聚集在右上角（附录K，图S19）。 在单个条件下（图4B），投射阴影（r = .810 r=.810，95% CI [ .424 , .960 ] [.424,.960]）和倒置面孔（r = .723 r=.723，[ .118 , .923 ] [.118,.923]）的正相关性表现稳健。 对于直立面孔，点估计值仍为正，但存在较大的估计不确定性（r = .667 r=.667，[ − .215 , .904 ] [-.215,.904]），而光线方向的相关性接近零（r = .051 r=.051，[ − .417 , .570 ] [-.417,.570]），表面反射则为负相关（r = − .371 r=-.371，[ − .704 , .364 ] [-.704,.364]；附录H）。 因此，尽管敏感性与对齐在整个任务中呈协变关系，但这种耦合在单个刺激条件下并非一致。

paragraphs.en: Dissociation along denoising schedules. Within individual models, violation sensitivity and human alignment systematically peak at different stages of the denoising schedule (Figure 5 A,B). Across normalized schedules ( [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] ), sensitivity peaked later (at cleaner noise levels) than human alignment in 20 of 25 models on Thatcher and in all 25 models on Illumination, with median within-model peak shifts of 0.141 0.141 and 0.444 0.444 (condition breakdowns in Appendix N ). This separation is consistent with the coarse-to-fine dynamics of generative diffusion ( Sclocchi et al., 2025 ; Tınaz et al., 2025 ; Görgün et al., 2026 ) : human alignment on relational tasks may peak at intermediate noise levels where global layout and contextual consistency are resolved, whereas later stages emphasize fine details that inflate loss penalties without refining perceptual agreement.
paragraphs.zh: 去噪时间表中的解离现象。 在单个模型内部，违规敏感性与人类对齐在去噪时间表的不同阶段系统性地达到峰值（图5A、B）。 在归一化的时间表（[0, 1]）中，在Thatcher数据集的25个模型中有20个模型，以及在Illumination数据集的全部25个模型中，敏感性比人类对齐更晚（在噪声水平更低时）达到峰值，各模型内峰值偏移的中位数分别为0.141和0.444（条件细分见附录N）。 这种分离与生成式扩散的“从粗到细”动态过程一致（Sclocchi等，2025；Tınaz等，2025；Görgün等，2026）：在关系性任务中，人类对齐可能在中间噪声水平达到峰值，此时全局布局和上下文一致性得以解决；而后期阶段则更强调精细细节，这些细节会放大损失惩罚，却无法提升感知一致性。

paragraphs.en: Connection to practical generation performance. Finally, as an exploratory analysis, we investigated whether loss-based perceptual alignment connects to practical generative capabilities (Appendix L ). We matched 11 image models to human-preference Elo ( Artificial Analysis, 2026 ) and seven video models to VBench Quality ( Huang et al., 2024 ) (Table S4 ). Model-level Spearman correlations between generation benchmarks and human alignment were positive on Illumination for image models ( ρ = .827 \rho=.827 ) and across both tasks for video models ( ρ = .929 \rho=.929 on Thatcher, ρ = .821 \rho=.821 on Illumination; Table S5 ), and these associations remained positive after controlling for violation sensitivity (partial ρ = .670 \rho=.670 for image models; .900 .900 and .778 .778 for video models). In contrast, the association on Thatcher images was weak both before and after adjustment ( ρ = .191 \rho=.191 and .182 .182 ), which may reflect ceiling effects as many models approach human-level agreement on faces (Figure 4 A). Conversely, reciprocal associations between generation benchmarks and violation sensitivity after controlling for alignment were uniformly weak across all four comparisons ( ρ = − .045 \rho=-.045 to .218 .218 ). While based on modest sample sizes, these exploratory associations suggest that loss-based perceptual alignment may reflect visual regularities that support practical generation quality.
paragraphs.zh: 与实际生成性能的相关性。 最后，作为一项探索性分析，我们研究了基于损失的感知对齐是否与实际的生成能力相关（附录 L）。 我们将 11 个图像模型与人类偏好 Elo 评分（Artificial Analysis, 2026）进行匹配，将 7 个视频模型与 VBench Quality 评分（Huang et al., 2024）进行匹配（表 S4）。 在图像模型中，生成基准测试与人类对齐之间的模型级斯皮尔曼相关系数在 Illumination 数据集上为正（ρ = .827 \rho=.827）；在视频模型中，两种任务的相关系数均为正（Thatcher 数据集上 ρ = .929 \rho=.929，Illumination 数据集上 ρ = .821 \rho=.821；表 S5）。在控制违规敏感度后，这些相关性仍然为正（图像模型的部分相关系数为 ρ = .670 \rho=.670；视频模型的相关系数分别为 .900 .900 和 .778 .778）。 相比之下，在 Thatcher 图像数据集上，调整前后相关性都很弱（ρ = .191 \rho=.191 和 .182 .182），这可能反映了天花板效应，因为许多模型在人脸识别上的表现已接近人类水平（图 4A）。 相反，在控制对齐因素后，生成基准测试与违规敏感度之间的反向相关性在所有四组比较中均较弱（ρ = − .045 \rho=-.045 至 .218 .218）。 尽管这些探索性相关性基于较小的样本量，但它们表明基于损失的感知对齐可能反映了支持实际生成质量的视觉规律。

paragraphs.en: This study evaluated whether the native prediction losses of visual generative models reflect human naturalness perception under controlled relational modifications. Across diverse architectures, zero-shot loss differences track continuous human ratings and retain complementary perceptual structure beyond standard vision encoders and image quality metrics. While coarse violation sensitivity broadly covaries with perceptual alignment across models, sensitivity and fine-grained alignment systematically dissociate along denoising schedules and vary across visual domains. These findings suggest that current generative models internalize structured relational regularities that partially mirror the selective sensitivities and tolerances of human naturalness perception, rather than merely signaling physical violations or generic visual divergence. Beyond characterizing existing architectures, this diagnostic framework provides a foundation to track how generative representations converge toward or diverge from biological perception as models scale.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究评估了视觉生成模型的原生预测损失是否在受控的关系性修改下反映了人类的自然性感知。 在不同架构中，零样本损失差异能够追踪连续的人类评分，并保留标准视觉编码器和图像质量指标之外的互补感知结构。 尽管粗略的违规敏感性在各模型中与感知一致性大致呈协变关系，但敏感性与精细的一致性在去噪流程中系统性地分离，并在不同视觉领域中存在差异。 这些发现表明，当前的生成模型内部化了结构化的关系性规律，这些规律部分反映了人类自然性感知的选择性敏感性和容忍度，而不仅仅是简单地标记物理违规或泛化的视觉差异。 除了对现有架构进行特征描述外，这一诊断框架还为追踪生成表示在模型扩展时如何趋近或偏离生物感知提供了基础。

paragraphs.en: Orientation dependence in face perception. Human sensitivity to relational facial distortions deteriorates sharply under inversion, a hallmark effect exemplified by the Thatcher illusion ( Thompson, 1980 ; de Haas & Schwarzkopf, 2018 ) . While this orientation dependence is known to emerge in feedforward networks ( Jacob et al., 2021 ) and was observed in our encoder baselines (Figure 1 B), generative models capture human judgments far more closely. Top generative models markedly outperform even layer-optimized encoders in human alignment on Thatcher, and bidirectional partial correlations confirm that they retain substantial explanatory power that encoder representations cannot account for (Figure 3 ). Notably, the ImageNet-trained JiT models ( Li & He, 2026 ) demonstrate that this orientation penalty can arise without training on a dedicated face dataset, scaling systematically with model capacity (Appendix G ). Generative losses also track naturalness variations within upright faces alone (median r = .493 r=.493 ), echoing findings that generative evidence tracks human facial attractiveness ( López & Triesch, 2026 ) . These results demonstrate that key characteristics of human face perception can emerge directly from statistical generative modeling of 2D images.
paragraphs.zh: 面部感知中的方向依赖性。 在图像倒置的情况下，人类对面部关系性畸变的敏感度会急剧下降，这是“撒切尔错觉”（Thompson, 1980；de Haas & Schwarzkopf, 2018）所体现的典型效应。 尽管这种方向依赖性已知会出现在前馈网络中（Jacob et al., 2021），并且在我们编码器的基线模型中也观察到了（图1B），但生成模型能更贴近地捕捉人类的判断。 顶尖的生成模型在“撒切尔错觉”任务上与人类判断的一致性上明显优于甚至经过层优化的编码器，而双向部分相关性分析也证实了它们保留了编码器表示无法解释的大量解释力（图3）。 值得注意的是，在ImageNet上训练的JiT模型（Li & He, 2026）表明，这种方向性惩罚无需在专门的面部数据集上进行训练即可出现，并且会随模型容量系统性地变化（附录G）。 生成损失还能追踪直立面部内部的自然度变化（中位数 r = .493），这与“生成证据能够反映人类对面部吸引力的判断”这一发现相呼应（López & Triesch, 2026）。 这些结果表明，人类面部感知的关键特征可以直接从二维图像的统计生成建模中涌现出来。

sents.zh: 生成损失还能追踪直立面部内部的自然度变化（中位数 r = .493），这与“生成证据能够反映人类对面部吸引力的判断”这一发现相呼应（López & Triesch, 2026）。

sents.en: These results demonstrate that key characteristics of human face perception can emerge directly from statistical generative modeling of 2D images.
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，人类面部感知的关键特征可以直接从二维图像的统计生成建模中涌现出来。

paragraphs.en: Physical scene illumination. In our Illumination experiments, human sensitivity to shadow and reflection inconsistencies depended strongly on scene geometry (Figure 1 B): observers readily detected violations for objects with distinctive directional landmarks (e.g., teapot), but tolerated errors for shapes lacking prominent spatial asymmetries (e.g., Spot). This selective sensitivity aligns with psychophysical accounts where directional landmarks facilitate spatial feature matching ( Casati, 2008 ; Farid & Bravo, 2010 ; Nightingale et al., 2019 ; Norman et al., 2009 ) . Generative losses systematically tracked this geometric selectivity across shadow and reflection rotations as well as lighting directions (Figure 1 B, Appendix J ), suggesting that rather than acting as objective detectors of physical violations, models rely on statistical correspondence cues that mirror human perceptual heuristics. However, models show a much weaker response to reflection hue shifts than humans do (Figure 1 B). While humans treat an impossible reflection color as a decisive physical violation, generative losses appear to penalize it only as a modest color difference relative to geometric misalignments. This divergence suggests that native loss landscapes may internalize relevant relational cues without weighting them in line with human perception.
paragraphs.zh: 物理场景的照明。 在我们的照明实验中，人类对阴影和反射不一致性的感知强烈依赖于场景几何结构（图 1B）：观察者能够轻易检测出具有明显方向性特征点（例如茶壶）的物体的异常，但对于缺乏显著空间不对称性的形状（例如 Spot），则能容忍错误。 这种选择性的感知与心理物理学解释一致，即方向性特征点有助于空间特征的匹配（Casati, 2008；Farid & Bravo, 2010；Nightingale et al., 2019；Norman et al., 2009）。 生成损失在阴影和反射旋转以及光照方向的变化中，系统性地反映了这种几何选择性（图 1B，附录 J），这表明模型并非作为物理异常的目标检测器，而是依赖与人类感知启发式方法相类似的统计对应线索。 然而，模型对反射色相变化的反应远弱于人类（图 1B）。 尽管人类会将不可能的反射颜色视为决定性的物理异常，但生成损失似乎仅将其视为相对于几何不匹配的一种轻微颜色差异进行惩罚。 这种差异表明，原生损失函数可能内化了相关的关系性线索，但并未按照人类的感知方式对其进行加权。

paragraphs.en: Model scaling and perceptual alignment. One might expect that scaling model capacity would steadily resolve such discrepancies, bringing models closer to an ideal observer of physical violations that automatically aligns with human perception. In exploratory comparisons, whole-task alignment did scale positively with model size (Appendix K , Figure S19 ), but this relationship did not uniformly extend to judgments within individual conditions. Most notably, for surface reflections, larger models grew steadily more sensitive to violations without showing any improvement in human alignment (Figure S21 ). This dissociation suggests that heightened sensitivity to visual perturbations does not guarantee alignment with the selective tolerances and weightings of human perception.
paragraphs.zh: 模型扩展与感知对齐。 人们或许会认为，扩大模型容量能够稳步解决此类差异，使模型更接近于一种理想观察者——这种观察者能自动识别物理规则违背，并与人类感知保持一致。 在初步比较中，整个任务的对齐度确实随模型规模增大而提升（附录 K，图 S19），但这种关系并未一致地延伸至各个单独条件下的判断。 尤其值得注意的是，对于表面反射现象，模型越大，对规则违背的敏感度持续增强，但并未表现出与人类感知对齐度的任何改善（图 S21）。 这种分离表明，对视觉扰动的敏感度提升，并不必然意味着能与人类感知中特定的容忍度和权重分配保持一致。

paragraphs.en: Limitations. Several limitations qualify these conclusions. First, our psychophysical intervention framework isolates relational regularities by minimizing low-level confounds, but this comes at the expense of scene diversity; extending controlled manipulations to unconstrained natural imagery without introducing low-level artifacts remains challenging. Second, because we evaluate off-the-shelf models, our comparisons cannot fully isolate core generative objectives from differences in model scale, architecture, or post-training recipes, nor can they disentangle generic visual statistics from human-curated preferences in modern training corpora. Finally, our analyses linking perceptual alignment to downstream generation benchmarks are observational, leaving open whether directly optimizing for human-aligned relational priors causally improves generation quality.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。 有几项局限性需要对这些结论加以限定。 首先，我们的心理物理干预框架通过最小化低层干扰因素来识别关系规律，但这样做是以牺牲场景多样性为代价的；在不引入低层伪影的前提下，将受控操作扩展到无约束的自然图像中仍然具有挑战性。 其次，由于我们评估的是现成模型，因此我们的比较无法完全将核心生成目标与模型规模、架构或训练后处理方案之间的差异区分开来，也无法将通用的视觉统计特征与现代训练语料库中由人类筛选出的偏好区分开。 最后，我们将感知对齐与下游生成基准相联系的分析仅属于观察性研究，因此目前尚不清楚直接优化与人类对齐的关系先验是否能在因果层面提升生成质量。

paragraphs.en: The stimulus set comprises 140 aligned 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 face identities, each evaluated across four conditions: original upright, Thatcherized upright, original inverted, and Thatcherized inverted (560 images total; construction procedure illustrated in Figure S1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 刺激集包含 140 组对齐的 1024 × 1024 人脸图像，每张图像均在四种条件下进行评估：原始正立、倒置 Thatcher 化正立、原始倒置和 Thatcher 化倒置（共 560 张图像；构建流程见图 S1）。

paragraphs.en: Source face images were sampled from the Flickr-Faces-HQ (FFHQ) dataset ( Karras et al., 2019 ) , which provides aligned 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 portraits. Source images were restricted to entries marked CC0 1.0 or Public Domain Mark 1.0 in the official FFHQ metadata ( ffhq-dataset-v2.json ). From this pool, we chose 140 distinct public-domain face identities for the experimental stimuli, and an additional 5 disjoint identities for practice trials (10 practice trials presenting original and modified pairs across orientations).
paragraphs.zh: 源人脸图像从 Flickr-Faces-HQ (FFHQ) 数据集（Karras 等人，2019）中采样，该数据集提供了经过对齐的 1024×1024 肖像图像。 源图像仅限于 FFHQ 官方元数据（ffhq-dataset-v2.json）中标记为 CC0 1.0 或公共领域标记 1.0 的条目。 从这些图像中，我们选择了 140 个不同的公共领域人脸身份作为实验刺激物，并额外选择了 5 个互不重叠的身份用于练习试验（包括 10 次练习试验，分别呈现不同朝向的原图与修改后的成对图像）。

paragraphs.en: To generate Thatcherized faces, we adapted the open-source pipeline by Alimohammadi (2020) (released under the GNU General Public License v3.0). For each face image, 68 facial landmarks were detected using dlib ( King, 2009 ) with its pre-trained shape predictor ( Kazemi & Sullivan, 2014 ) (Figure S1 A). Landmarks corresponding to the left eye (points 36–41), right eye (points 42–47), and mouth (points 48–67) were used to define bounding regions with modest padding offsets around each feature (Figure S1 B, dashed rectangles). Within each feature region, pixels inside an elliptical mask were vertically inverted in place across the feature’s horizontal midline (Figure S1 B, solid ellipses). To minimize high-contrast seam artifacts and artificial edges, Gaussian blending feathered the transition along the elliptical perimeter into the surrounding skin. Inverted stimuli were generated by rotating both the original and Thatcherized images by 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} (Figure S1 C).
paragraphs.zh: 为了生成“撒切尔化”人脸，我们对 Alimohammadi（2020）开发的开源流程进行了调整（该流程根据 GNU 通用公共许可证 v3.0 发布）。 对于每张人脸图像，我们使用 dlib（King, 2009）及其预训练的形状预测器（Kazemi & Sullivan, 2014）检测出 68 个人脸关键点（图 S1A）。 我们将左眼（第 36–41 个点）、右眼（第 42–47 个点）和嘴巴（第 48–67 个点）对应的关键点用于定义边界区域，并在每个特征周围添加适度的填充偏移量（图 S1B，虚线矩形）。 在每个特征区域内，椭圆掩膜内的像素沿该特征的水平中线进行原地垂直翻转（图 S1B，实线椭圆）。 为了最小化高对比度的接缝伪影和人工边缘，我们使用高斯混合对椭圆边界沿其周长与周围皮肤的过渡区域进行了羽化处理。 通过将原始图像和“撒切尔化”图像均旋转 180°（180^{\circ}），生成了翻转后的刺激图像（图 S1C）。

sents.en: To generate Thatcherized faces, we adapted the open-source pipeline by Alimohammadi (2020) (released under the GNU General Public License v3.0).
sents.zh: 为了生成“撒切尔化”人脸，我们对 Alimohammadi（2020）开发的开源流程进行了调整（该流程根据 GNU 通用公共许可证 v3.0 发布）。

sents.en: For each face image, 68 facial landmarks were detected using dlib ( King, 2009 ) with its pre-trained shape predictor ( Kazemi & Sullivan, 2014 ) (Figure S1 A).
sents.zh: 对于每张人脸图像，我们使用 dlib（King, 2009）及其预训练的形状预测器（Kazemi & Sullivan, 2014）检测出 68 个人脸关键点（图 S1A）。

sents.en: Landmarks corresponding to the left eye (points 36–41), right eye (points 42–47), and mouth (points 48–67) were used to define bounding regions with modest padding offsets around each feature (Figure S1 B, dashed rectangles).
sents.zh: 我们将左眼（第 36–41 个点）、右眼（第 42–47 个点）和嘴巴（第 48–67 个点）对应的关键点用于定义边界区域，并在每个特征周围添加适度的填充偏移量（图 S1B，虚线矩形）。

sents.en: Within each feature region, pixels inside an elliptical mask were vertically inverted in place across the feature’s horizontal midline (Figure S1 B, solid ellipses).
sents.zh: 在每个特征区域内，椭圆掩膜内的像素沿该特征的水平中线进行原地垂直翻转（图 S1B，实线椭圆）。

sents.en: To minimize high-contrast seam artifacts and artificial edges, Gaussian blending feathered the transition along the elliptical perimeter into the surrounding skin.
sents.zh: 为了最小化高对比度的接缝伪影和人工边缘，我们使用高斯混合对椭圆边界沿其周长与周围皮肤的过渡区域进行了羽化处理。

sents.en: Inverted stimuli were generated by rotating both the original and Thatcherized images by 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} (Figure S1 C).
sents.zh: 通过将原始图像和“撒切尔化”图像均旋转 180°（180^{\circ}），生成了翻转后的刺激图像（图 S1C）。

paragraphs.en: We generated synthetic 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 stimuli using Kubric ( Greff et al., 2022 ) across three physical operations: cast shadows ( Shadow ), surface reflections ( Reflection ), and lighting direction ( Light direction ). Each operation comprised 48 base configurations. Horizontally mirroring each base pair produced another 48 pairs, yielding 96 pairs per operation and 288 pairs in total.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Kubric（Greff 等人，2022）生成了合成 1024 × 1024 的 1024\times 1024 刺激物，涵盖三种物理操作：投射阴影（Shadow）、表面反射（Reflection）和光照方向（Light direction）。 每种操作包含 48 种基础配置。 对每对基础配置进行水平镜像，又生成了另外 48 对，因此每种操作得到 96 对，总计 288 对。

sents.en: We generated synthetic 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 stimuli using Kubric ( Greff et al., 2022 ) across three physical operations: cast shadows ( Shadow ), surface reflections ( Reflection ), and lighting direction ( Light direction ).
sents.zh: 我们使用 Kubric（Greff 等人，2022）生成了合成 1024 × 1024 的 1024\times 1024 刺激物，涵盖三种物理操作：投射阴影（Shadow）、表面反射（Reflection）和光照方向（Light direction）。

sents.en: Each operation comprised 48 base configurations.
sents.zh: 每种操作包含 48 种基础配置。

sents.en: Horizontally mirroring each base pair produced another 48 pairs, yielding 96 pairs per operation and 288 pairs in total.
sents.zh: 对每对基础配置进行水平镜像，又生成了另外 48 对，因此每种操作得到 96 对，总计 288 对。

paragraphs.en: In Shadow and Reflection , we horizontally flipped the floor region while leaving the objects unchanged, exchanging their shadows or reflections (Figure S2 ). The two objects were placed symmetrically about the image’s vertical midline, so the flip mapped their positions onto one another without introducing a positional offset. Additionally, objects were elevated above the floor (see below) to ensure a spatial gap; if objects contacted the ground, swapping the floor would alter contact contours or introduce spurious edge discontinuities at the object base, confounding loss differences with low-level edge artifacts. In Light direction , we horizontally flipped the central object while leaving the floor and flanking objects unchanged. This reversed its shading relative to the flanking objects and, in low-height scenes, disrupted the correspondence between its shading and its unchanged cast shadow. Every intervention rearranged existing pixels without adding newly rendered visual content.
paragraphs.zh: 在“阴影与反射”实验中，我们对地板区域进行了水平翻转，同时保持物体不变，从而交换了它们的阴影或反射（图 S2）。 两个物体对称地放置在图像的垂直中线上，因此翻转操作将它们的位置相互对应，而没有引入位置偏移。 此外，我们将物体抬高至地板之上（见下文），以确保存在空间间隙；如果物体与地面接触，交换地板会改变接触轮廓，或在物体底部产生虚假的边缘不连续性，从而将损失差异与低层边缘伪影混淆。 在“光照方向”实验中，我们对中心物体进行了水平翻转，同时保持地板和两侧物体不变。 这使得其明暗分布相对于两侧物体发生了反转，并且在低高度场景中，破坏了其明暗分布与未改变的投射阴影之间的对应关系。 所有干预措施都仅对现有像素进行重新排列，并未添加任何新渲染的视觉内容。

sents.zh: 在“光照方向”实验中，我们对中心物体进行了水平翻转，同时保持地板和两侧物体不变。

paragraphs.en: Figures S3 – S8 illustrate the stimuli across all 44 analysis levels evaluated in Appendix J . To present these levels concisely without displaying every factorial combination, object variations (shape, rotation, and color) are shown under shared baseline settings, while separate pairwise panels show both levels of each environmental factor (such as height, shadow softness, or surface roughness).
paragraphs.zh: 图 S3 – S8 展示了附录 J 中评估的全部 44 个分析层级中的刺激物。 为了简洁地呈现这些层级而不显示所有因子组合，物体变化（形状、旋转和颜色）在共享的基准设置下展示，而独立的成对面板则显示了每个环境因素（如高度、阴影柔和度或表面粗糙度）的两个层级。

sents.en: Figures S3 – S8 illustrate the stimuli across all 44 analysis levels evaluated in Appendix J .
sents.zh: 图 S3 – S8 展示了附录 J 中评估的全部 44 个分析层级中的刺激物。

sents.en: To present these levels concisely without displaying every factorial combination, object variations (shape, rotation, and color) are shown under shared baseline settings, while separate pairwise panels show both levels of each environmental factor (such as height, shadow softness, or surface roughness).
sents.zh: 为了简洁地呈现这些层级而不显示所有因子组合，物体变化（形状、旋转和颜色）在共享的基准设置下展示，而独立的成对面板则显示了每个环境因素（如高度、阴影柔和度或表面粗糙度）的两个层级。

paragraphs.en: For Shadow , six Shape pair cases (S1) and six Rotation cases (S2) were each crossed with Height (S3: low, 0.1; high, 0.3) and Shadow softness (S4: soft or hard), giving ( 6 + 6 ) × 2 × 2 = 48 (6+6)\times 2\times 2=48 base configurations. Soft shadows have blurred edges and were produced by a large area light; hard shadows have sharp edges and were produced by a small, point-like light source.
paragraphs.zh: 对于阴影而言，六个形状配对案例（S1）和六个旋转案例（S2）分别与高度（S3：低，0.1；高，0.3）和阴影柔和度（S4：柔和或坚硬）进行组合，得到 (6 + 6) × 2 × 2 = 48 种基础配置。 柔和的阴影边缘模糊，由大面积光源产生；坚硬的阴影边缘锐利，由小型点状光源产生。

sents.en: For Shadow , six Shape pair cases (S1) and six Rotation cases (S2) were each crossed with Height (S3: low, 0.1; high, 0.3) and Shadow softness (S4: soft or hard), giving ( 6 + 6 ) × 2 × 2 = 48 (6+6)\times 2\times 2=48 base configurations.
sents.zh: 对于阴影而言，六个形状配对案例（S1）和六个旋转案例（S2）分别与高度（S3：低，0.1；高，0.3）和阴影柔和度（S4：柔和或坚硬）进行组合，得到 (6 + 6) × 2 × 2 = 48 种基础配置。

sents.en: Soft shadows have blurred edges and were produced by a large area light; hard shadows have sharp edges and were produced by a small, point-like light source.
sents.zh: 柔和的阴影边缘模糊，由大面积光源产生；坚硬的阴影边缘锐利，由小型点状光源产生。

paragraphs.en: For Reflection , four Shape pair cases (R1), four Rotation cases (R2), and four Color cases (R3) were each crossed with Height (R4: low, 0.1; high, 0.3) and Floor roughness (R5: smooth, 0.0; rough, 0.3), giving ( 4 + 4 + 4 ) × 2 × 2 = 48 (4+4+4)\times 2\times 2=48 configurations. The four Color cases combine two shapes, cube and torus, with a small or large hue shift (0.05 or 0.5 turns on the hue circle). Smooth floors produce mirror-like reflections; rough floors blur them. Shape pair, Rotation, and Color are separate sets of cases, not mutually crossed factors.
paragraphs.zh: 在“反射”实验中，四组形状配对案例（R1）、四组旋转案例（R2）和四组颜色案例（R3）分别与高度（R4：低，0.1；高，0.3）和地面粗糙度（R5：光滑，0.0；粗糙，0.3）进行交叉组合，从而得到 (4 + 4 + 4) × 2 × 2 = 48 种配置。 四组颜色案例将两种形状——立方体和环面——与较小或较大的色调偏移（在色相环上偏移 0.05 或 0.5 圈）相结合。 光滑的地面会产生类似镜面的反射；粗糙的地面则会使这些反射变得模糊。 形状配对、旋转和颜色是独立的案例集合，彼此之间并非交叉因素。

sents.en: For Reflection , four Shape pair cases (R1), four Rotation cases (R2), and four Color cases (R3) were each crossed with Height (R4: low, 0.1; high, 0.3) and Floor roughness (R5: smooth, 0.0; rough, 0.3), giving ( 4 + 4 + 4 ) × 2 × 2 = 48 (4+4+4)\times 2\times 2=48 configurations.
sents.zh: 在“反射”实验中，四组形状配对案例（R1）、四组旋转案例（R2）和四组颜色案例（R3）分别与高度（R4：低，0.1；高，0.3）和地面粗糙度（R5：光滑，0.0；粗糙，0.3）进行交叉组合，从而得到 (4 + 4 + 4) × 2 × 2 = 48 种配置。

sents.zh: 四组颜色案例将两种形状——立方体和环面——与较小或较大的色调偏移（在色相环上偏移 0.05 或 0.5 圈）相结合。

paragraphs.en: For Light direction , six levels of Shape (L1: cube, cylinder, sphere, Spot, teapot, and torus knot) were fully crossed with Material (L2: diffuse or metal), Height (L3: low, 0.2; high, 2.0), and Light angle (L4: 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} or 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} ), giving 6 × 2 × 2 × 2 = 48 6\times 2\times 2\times 2=48 configurations. Cast shadows were disabled in the high condition. Heights are expressed in renderer scene units.
paragraphs.zh: 在光照方向方面，形状（L1：立方体、圆柱体、球体、聚光灯、茶壶和环面结）的六个层级与材质（L2：漫反射或金属）、高度（L3：低，0.2；高，2.0）以及光照角度（L4：15° 15^{\circ} 或 30° 30^{\circ}）进行了全面组合，从而得到 6 × 2 × 2 × 2 = 48 种配置。 在高高度条件下，阴影投射被禁用。 高度以渲染器场景单位为单位表示。

paragraphs.en: Online psychophysical experiments were developed using jsPsych (v7) ( de Leeuw et al., 2023 ) and hosted on a dedicated web server. Prior to starting the experiment, participants were required to switch their browsers to full-screen mode, and automated checks verified compatible rendering environments. Stimuli were displayed in the center of the screen at 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixels against a neutral background.
paragraphs.zh: 在线心理物理实验是使用 jsPsych（v7）（de Leeuw 等人，2023）开发的，并部署在专用网络服务器上。 在开始实验之前，参与者需要将浏览器切换到全屏模式，并通过自动化检查验证渲染环境的兼容性。 刺激物以 512 × 512 像素的分辨率显示在屏幕中央，背景为中性色。

sents.en: Online psychophysical experiments were developed using jsPsych (v7) ( de Leeuw et al., 2023 ) and hosted on a dedicated web server.
sents.zh: 在线心理物理实验是使用 jsPsych（v7）（de Leeuw 等人，2023）开发的，并部署在专用网络服务器上。

sents.en: Prior to starting the experiment, participants were required to switch their browsers to full-screen mode, and automated checks verified compatible rendering environments.

sents.en: Stimuli were displayed in the center of the screen at 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixels against a neutral background.
sents.zh: 刺激物以 512 × 512 像素的分辨率显示在屏幕中央，背景为中性色。

paragraphs.en: Participants provided naturalness ratings on a discrete 5-point horizontal slider with text labels: 1 ( Very unnatural ), 2 ( Unnatural ), 3 ( Slightly unnatural ), 4 ( Moderately natural ), and 5 ( Natural ). To avoid anchoring effects, the slider handle was initialized to a random integer position ( 1 ​ – ​ 5 1\text{--}5 ) on every trial. Participants had to click or move the handle before the continue button was enabled, so that retaining the initial position required an active response. Stimuli remained on screen without time limits until submitted, followed by a 500 ms blank inter-trial interval (ITI).
paragraphs.zh: 参与者通过一个带文本标签的离散 5 点水平滑块对自然度进行评分：1（非常不自然）、2（不自然）、3（略微不自然）、4（中等自然）和 5（自然）。 为避免锚定效应，每次试验中滑块手柄都会被初始化为一个随机整数位置（1–5）。 参与者必须在“继续”按钮启用前点击或移动手柄，因此保持初始位置需要主动操作。 刺激物在没有时间限制的情况下持续显示在屏幕上，直到提交，之后会进入 500 毫秒的空白试间期（ITI）。

sents.en: Participants provided naturalness ratings on a discrete 5-point horizontal slider with text labels: 1 ( Very unnatural ), 2 ( Unnatural ), 3 ( Slightly unnatural ), 4 ( Moderately natural ), and 5 ( Natural ).
sents.zh: 参与者通过一个带文本标签的离散 5 点水平滑块对自然度进行评分：1（非常不自然）、2（不自然）、3（略微不自然）、4（中等自然）和 5（自然）。

sents.en: To avoid anchoring effects, the slider handle was initialized to a random integer position ( 1 ​ – ​ 5 1\text{--}5 ) on every trial.
sents.zh: 为避免锚定效应，每次试验中滑块手柄都会被初始化为一个随机整数位置（1–5）。

sents.en: Participants had to click or move the handle before the continue button was enabled, so that retaining the initial position required an active response.
sents.zh: 参与者必须在“继续”按钮启用前点击或移动手柄，因此保持初始位置需要主动操作。

sents.en: Stimuli remained on screen without time limits until submitted, followed by a 500 ms blank inter-trial interval (ITI).
sents.zh: 刺激物在没有时间限制的情况下持续显示在屏幕上，直到提交，之后会进入 500 毫秒的空白试间期（ITI）。

paragraphs.en: Because the stimulus manipulations introduced subtle violations of configural or physical regularities within otherwise realistic scenes, relying solely on an unguided, generic query of “naturalness” risks inattentive oversights or idiosyncratic evaluation criteria (e.g., judging superficial photographic aesthetics rather than physical plausibility). To ensure that participants attended to the critical structural attributes and to calibrate rating criteria across observers, participants were familiarized with the candidate manipulation types through illustrated instructions and visual examples prior to the experiment:
paragraphs.zh: 由于刺激操控在原本逼真的场景中引入了对配置性或物理性规律的细微违背，因此仅依赖未经引导的通用“自然性”评估，可能会导致因注意力不集中而造成的疏漏或因人而异的评价标准（例如，评判表面的摄影美学而非物理上的合理性）。 为确保参与者关注关键的结构属性，并统一不同观察者的评分标准，实验前通过图文说明和视觉示例，让参与者熟悉了可能的操控类型：

paragraphs.en: Thatcher task: Participants were instructed: “Rate the naturalness of the facial appearance on a 5-point scale. Internal facial parts (eyes and mouth) may have artificial image manipulations applied. If you perceive a natural face without manipulation, select 5 (Natural). If you feel unnaturalness due to manipulation, select 1–4 according to the degree of unnaturalness. Faces may also appear upside down; please evaluate them using the same criteria, and refrain from physically tilting your head or rotating your display.”
paragraphs.zh: 撒切尔任务：参与者被指示：“请在 5 分制量表上评价面部外观的自然程度。 面部内部部分（眼睛和嘴巴）可能经过了人工图像处理。 如果您认为这是一张没有经过处理的自然面孔，请选择 5（自然）。 如果您因处理而感觉到不自然，请根据不自然的程度选择 1–4。 面孔也可能呈现倒置状态；请使用相同的标准进行评价，并且不要实际倾斜头部或旋转显示屏。”

paragraphs.en: The 140 base face scenes ( 140 × 2 ​ orientations = 280 ​ pairs 140\times 2\text{ orientations}=280\text{ pairs} ; 560 images) were divided into four disjoint sets of 35 (A–D). The four observer groups viewed A upright and B inverted, B upright and C inverted, C upright and D inverted, or D upright and A inverted. Each participant therefore viewed 35 upright faces and 35 different inverted faces, with each identity presented in only one orientation. Both original and modified versions of each scene were evaluated by the same participant, providing within-subject paired perceptual differences h i = R ⁡ ( x i orig ) − R ⁡ ( x i mod ) h_{i}=R(x_{i}^{\mathrm{orig}})-R(x_{i}^{\mathrm{mod}}) . Each main block contained 140 trials (35 upright faces plus 35 different inverted faces, each shown in original and modified versions) and 6 repeated trials for reliability checking (146 trials total). In data processing, repeated trials were deduplicated by retaining the first presentation.
paragraphs.zh: 140个基础面部场景（140 × 2种朝向 = 280对；560张图像）被划分为四个互斥的集合，每个集合包含35个场景（A–D）。 四个观察者组分别观看了A的正立图像与B的倒立图像、B的正立图像与C的倒立图像、C的正立图像与D的倒立图像，或D的正立图像与A的倒立图像。 因此，每位参与者观看了35张正立面部图像和35张不同的倒立面部图像，且每张面孔仅以单一朝向呈现。 每个场景的原始版本和修改版本都由同一位参与者进行评价，从而获得被试内成对感知差异 h i = R ⁡ ( x i orig ) − R ⁡ ( x i mod ) h_{i}=R(x_{i}^{\mathrm{orig}})-R(x_{i}^{\mathrm{mod}}) 。 每个主区块包含140次试验（35张正立面部图像和35张不同的倒立面部图像，每张均以原始版本和修改版本呈现）以及6次重复试验用于可靠性检查（总计146次试验）。 在数据处理中，通过保留首次呈现的结果去除了重复试验。

paragraphs.en: The three illumination interventions (Shadow, Reflection, Light direction; 96 scenes each, 288 pairs total) were evaluated in a between-subjects design: each participant evaluated only one intervention type. Within each intervention, the 96 scenes were randomly divided into four disjoint subsets of 24. Each of four observer groups evaluated a different combination of three subsets (72 scenes), so each scene was evaluated by three of the four groups. Both original and modified versions of each assigned scene were evaluated within-subject. Each main block contained 144 trials ( 72 ​ scenes × 2 ​ versions 72\text{ scenes}\times 2\text{ versions} ) and 6 repeated trials (150 trials total; first presentation retained).
paragraphs.zh: 三种光照干预（阴影、反射、光方向；每种包含96个场景，共288对）通过被试间设计进行评估：每位参与者仅评估一种干预类型。 在每种干预中，96个场景被随机划分为四个互不重叠的24个场景子集。 四个观察者小组中的每个小组都评估了三种子集的不同组合（72个场景），因此每个场景都由四个小组中的三个小组进行了评估。 每个分配到的场景的原版和修改版均通过被试内设计进行评估。 每个主块包含144次试验（72个场景 × 2个版本）和6次重复试验（共150次试验；首次呈现的结果予以保留）。

sents.en: The three illumination interventions (Shadow, Reflection, Light direction; 96 scenes each, 288 pairs total) were evaluated in a between-subjects design: each participant evaluated only one intervention type.

sents.zh: 每个分配到的场景的原版和修改版均通过被试内设计进行评估。

sents.en: Each main block contained 144 trials ( 72 ​ scenes × 2 ​ versions 72\text{ scenes}\times 2\text{ versions} ) and 6 repeated trials (150 trials total; first presentation retained).

paragraphs.en: Each session progressed through: full-screen switch → \to illustrated instructions → \to a practice block (10 trials for Thatcher; condition-specific practice for Illumination) → \to an option to re-read instructions → \to the main block with trials presented in randomized order → \to data submission.
paragraphs.zh: 每个会话的流程如下：全屏切换 → \to 图文说明 → \to 练习环节（Thatcher 任务进行 10 次试验；Illumination 任务则进行条件特定的练习）→ \to 重新阅读说明的选项 → \to 以随机顺序呈现试验的主要环节 → \to 提交数据。

paragraphs.en: Participants were adults aged 20–49 years, with balanced representation across age groups (20s, 30s, and 40s) and sexes. A total of 162 participant submissions were collected for the Thatcher task and 167 for the Illumination task. Since two Illumination submissions came from duplicate participant identities, we retained each participant’s first submission while discarding the latter, leaving 165 participants before response-consistency screening. Although the experiment included 6 repeated trials originally intended for intra-subject test–retest screening, strict consistency filtering on these few trials proved overly conservative due to normal perceptual rating jitter on the 5-point scale, excluding an unnecessarily large fraction of otherwise attentive participants. We therefore adopted a global response-consistency screening criterion. Repeated trials were deduplicated by retaining the first presentation, and for each participant, we computed the Pearson correlation r r between their ratings across unique images and the corresponding image-wise mean ratings of all other participants who rated those images.
paragraphs.zh: 参与者为 20–49 岁的成年人，各年龄组（20 多岁、30 多岁和 40 多岁）及性别分布均衡。 在 Thatcher 任务中共收集到 162 份参与者提交的数据，在 Illumination 任务中则收集到 167 份。 由于有两份 Illumination 任务的提交来自重复的参与者身份，我们保留了每位参与者的第一份提交并舍弃了后者，因此在响应一致性筛选前共有 165 名参与者。 尽管实验最初包含了 6 次重复试验，用于受试者内部的测试-重测筛选，但针对这几次试验的严格一致性过滤被证明过于保守，因为 5 分制量表上存在正常的感知评分波动，导致本应专注的参与者中不必要地排除了较大比例。 因此，我们采用了一种全局性的响应一致性筛选标准。 重复试验通过保留首次呈现的结果去重；对于每位参与者，我们计算了他们针对独特图像的评分与所有其他参与者在这些图像上的对应图像均值评分之间的皮尔逊相关系数 r。
