sents.en: Although the experiment included 6 repeated trials originally intended for intra-subject test–retest screening, strict consistency filtering on these few trials proved overly conservative due to normal perceptual rating jitter on the 5-point scale, excluding an unnecessarily large fraction of otherwise attentive participants.

sents.en: Repeated trials were deduplicated by retaining the first presentation, and for each participant, we computed the Pearson correlation r r between their ratings across unique images and the corresponding image-wise mean ratings of all other participants who rated those images.

paragraphs.en: We estimated a Gaussian kernel density for each task using Silverman’s rule-of-thumb bandwidth ( Silverman, 1986 ) , b = 0.9 min ( s , IQR / 1.34 ) n − 1 / 5 b=0.9\min(s,\mathrm{IQR}/1.34)n^{-1/5} , where s s , IQR \mathrm{IQR} , and n n are the sample standard deviation, interquartile range, and number of finite correlations. We selected the deepest trough relative to its flanking peaks (Figure S9 ), yielding cutoffs of r = .2481 r=.2481 for Thatcher and r = .3236 r=.3236 for Illumination. Retaining participants who met or exceeded these thresholds left 143 participants for Thatcher (88.3%) and 105 for Illumination (63.6%).
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Silverman 的经验法则带宽（Silverman, 1986），即 b = 0.9 min(s, IQR / 1.34) n^{-1/5}，为每个任务估算了高斯核密度，其中 s、IQR 和 n 分别是样本标准差、四分位距和有限相关项的数量。 我们选择了相对于其两侧峰值的最深谷值（图 S9），由此得到 Thatcher 的截断值为 r = 0.2481，Illumination 的截断值为 r = 0.3236。 保留达到或超过这些阈值的参与者后，Thatcher 组剩余 143 名参与者（88.3%），Illumination 组剩余 105 名参与者（63.6%）。

paragraphs.en: The variation in sample size across Illumination conditions stemmed primarily from differences in exclusion rates during screening: before screening, the Shadow, Reflection, and Light-direction conditions enrolled 69, 44, and 52 participants, of whom 15 (21.7%), 9 (20.5%), and 36 (69.2%), respectively, were excluded. In participant-disjoint split-half analyses (10,000 group-stratified random splits), split-half reliability in the Light-direction condition was r = .144 r=.144 among excluded participants, compared with r = .668 r=.668 among retained participants (and .960 .960 for Shadow, .932 .932 for Reflection). The excluded Light-direction group showed little average separation between original and modified ratings: the mean original-minus-modified difference across the 96 pairs was 0.051 0.051 points, compared with 0.996 0.996 points in the retained group.
paragraphs.zh: 不同光照条件下样本量的差异主要源于筛选过程中排除率的不同：在筛选前，阴影、反射和光照方向条件下的受试者人数分别为 69、44 和 52 人，其中分别有 15（21.7%）、9（20.5%）和 36（69.2%）人被排除。 在互不重叠的受试者二分分析中（10,000 次按组分层随机划分），光照方向条件下被排除受试者的二分可靠性为 r = .144 r=.144，而保留受试者的二分可靠性则为 r = .668 r=.668（阴影条件为 .960 .960，反射条件为 .932 .932）。 被排除的光照方向组在原始评分与修改后评分之间的平均差异很小：96 对评分中，原始评分减去修改后评分的平均差值为 0.051 0.051 分，而保留组这一差值为 0.996 0.996 分。

sents.en: The variation in sample size across Illumination conditions stemmed primarily from differences in exclusion rates during screening: before screening, the Shadow, Reflection, and Light-direction conditions enrolled 69, 44, and 52 participants, of whom 15 (21.7%), 9 (20.5%), and 36 (69.2%), respectively, were excluded.

paragraphs.en: To verify that our findings do not depend on the specific screening threshold, we recomputed all item-level aggregates without any participant exclusions. The unfiltered item aggregates correlated closely with the screened aggregates ( r = .986 r=.986 for Thatcher, r = .942 r=.942 for Illumination), and the cross-model sensitivity–alignment association was preserved ( r = .663 r=.663 with and without screening on Thatcher; .821 .821 with screening and .847 .847 without screening on Illumination). Because Light direction had the highest exclusion rate, we checked whether screening affected model–human correspondence in this condition. Across the 96 image pairs, the mean original–modified rating differences calculated from all 52 participants closely tracked those from the 16 retained participants ( r = .891 r=.891 ). Model–human correlations were also similar (median across all 25 generative models: .277 .277 with screening and .255 .255 without).
paragraphs.zh: 为了验证我们的研究结果不依赖于特定的筛选阈值，我们重新计算了所有项目层面的聚合值，且未排除任何参与者。 未经筛选的项目聚合值与经过筛选的聚合值高度相关（Thatcher 任务中 r = .986，Illumination 任务中 r = .942），并且跨模型敏感度–一致性关联也得以保留（在 Thatcher 任务中，无论是否进行筛选，r = .663；在 Illumination 任务中，进行筛选时 r = .821，未进行筛选时 r = .847）。 由于 Light direction 的排除率最高，我们检查了筛选是否影响了该条件下模型与人类的一致性。 在 96 对图像中，基于全部 52 名参与者计算出的原始–修改评分差异平均值，与基于保留的 16 名参与者计算出的结果高度一致（r = .891）。 模型–人类的相关性也相似（在所有 25 个生成模型中的中位数：进行筛选时为 .277，未进行筛选时为 .255）。

paragraphs.en: This section summarizes the common loss probing setup and specifications for all 25 evaluated generative models (Table S1 ). Model-specific schedulers, identifiers, and environment configurations are archived with the accompanying code and configuration files.
paragraphs.zh: 本节总结了所有 25 个受评估的生成模型（表 S1）中通用的损失探测设置和规格。 各模型特定的调度器、标识符和环境配置已随附代码及配置文件一同归档。

sents.en: This section summarizes the common loss probing setup and specifications for all 25 evaluated generative models (Table S1 ).

paragraphs.en: For each generative model m m and test image x x , the model-native loss L m ​ ( x ) L_{m}(x) is computed by averaging its squared prediction error across a fixed grid of timesteps T m T_{m} and noise realizations E m E_{m} :
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个生成模型 m m 和测试图像 x x，模型原生损失 L m ​ ( x ) L_{m}(x) 是通过对其在固定时间步网格 T m T_{m} 和噪声实现 E m E_{m} 上的平方预测误差取平均来计算得出的：

paragraphs.en: Here, ℓ m \ell_{m} is the mean squared error in the parameterization of the model’s denoising objective (noise, velocity, or flow), averaged over channel, spatial, and, where applicable, temporal dimensions. For latent-space models, losses are evaluated on encoded inputs and do not include an image-reconstruction term. JiT and PixelGen ( Li & He, 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ) predict clean images and compute their denoising losses in velocity space. We follow this definition, using the residual ( x ^ − x ) / max ⁡ ( 1 − t , 0.05 ) (\hat{x}-x)/\max(1-t,0.05) , where x ^ \hat{x} is the predicted clean image, t t is the clean-image interpolation coefficient, and the denominator floor follows the original implementations.
paragraphs.zh: 此处，ℓ m \ell_{m} 是模型去噪目标（噪声、速度或流）参数化中的均方误差，该误差在通道、空间以及适用情况下时间维度上取平均值。 对于潜在空间模型，损失函数在编码后的输入上进行评估，且不包含图像重建项。 JiT 和 PixelGen（Li & He, 2026；Ma et al., 2026）预测干净图像，并在速度空间中计算其去噪损失。 我们遵循这一定义，使用残差 ( x ^ − x ) / max ⁡ ( 1 − t , 0.05 ) (\hat{x}-x)/\max(1-t,0.05)，其中 x ^ \hat{x} 是预测的干净图像，t t 是干净图像的插值系数，而分母中的 floor 操作遵循原始实现。

paragraphs.en: Timestep grids ( T m T_{m} ). Image models were evaluated at 100 scheduler-defined timesteps and video models at 50. The grids followed each model’s implemented variance-preserving or shifted-flow schedule and were averaged with equal weight; their numerical timestep coordinates are model-specific and not directly comparable across architectures.
paragraphs.zh: 时间步网格（ T m T_{m} ）。 图像模型在调度器定义的 100 个时间步上进行评估，视频模型则在 50 个时间步上进行评估。 这些网格遵循每个模型所实现的方差保持或流偏移调度方案，并以相等的权重进行平均；其数值时间步坐标因模型而异，不同架构之间无法直接比较。

sents.zh: 时间步网格（ T m T_{m} ）。

paragraphs.en: Noise realizations ( E m E_{m} ). Each model evaluation used a fixed bank of 20 standard Gaussian noise tensors. This bank was instantiated once and shared across all stimuli and both members of each pair, isolating content-dependent differences under matched noise draws.
paragraphs.zh: 噪声实现（E m E_{m}）。 每次模型评估都使用了一个包含 20 个标准高斯噪声张量的固定库。 该库被实例化一次，并在所有刺激以及每对的两个成员之间共享，从而在匹配的噪声抽取下隔离了与内容相关的差异。

paragraphs.en: Conditioning and guidance. Unconditional models used their native null-class or unconditional branch. Text-conditioned models used an empty or neutral prompt in a single forward pass without classifier-free guidance (CFG) branch mixing. The embedded guidance scale was set to 1.0 1.0 for both FLUX.1 dev and HunyuanVideo.

paragraphs.en: Image preprocessing. All 16 image models received RGB inputs resized to 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixels before model-specific normalization or latent encoding.

paragraphs.en: Video preprocessing. Each source RGB image was resized by bilinear interpolation to fit the model’s input resolution (Table S1 ), preserving aspect ratio, then center-padded with a constant value of .5 .5 . The padded frame was repeated to form a static clip. CogVideoX1.5 uses 21 repeats to yield six latent frames, satisfying its two-frame temporal patch size; the other eight models use 17.
paragraphs.zh: 视频预处理。 每个源 RGB 图像通过双线性插值进行缩放，以匹配模型输入分辨率（表 S1），同时保持宽高比，然后用 .5 .5 的常数值进行中心填充。 重复填充后的帧以生成静态片段。 CogVideoX1.5 使用 21 次重复来生成六个潜在帧，以满足其两帧的时间切片大小；其余八种模型则使用 17 次重复。

paragraphs.en: To benchmark generative loss against non-generative alternatives, we evaluate a heterogeneous pool of 12 frozen image encoders alongside two prespecified five-metric IQA batteries (full-reference and no-reference; Table S3 ). All model weights and scoring protocols are held fixed without task-specific fine-tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 为了将生成性损失与非生成性方法进行比较，我们对 12 个冻结的图像编码器组成的异构集合以及两种预先指定的五指标 IQA 电池（全参考和无参考；表 S3）进行了评估。 所有模型权重和评分协议均保持固定，未进行任务特定的微调。

sents.en: To benchmark generative loss against non-generative alternatives, we evaluate a heterogeneous pool of 12 frozen image encoders alongside two prespecified five-metric IQA batteries (full-reference and no-reference; Table S3 ).
sents.zh: 为了将生成性损失与非生成性方法进行比较，我们对 12 个冻结的图像编码器组成的异构集合以及两种预先指定的五指标 IQA 电池（全参考和无参考；表 S3）进行了评估。

sents.en: All model weights and scoring protocols are held fixed without task-specific fine-tuning.
sents.zh: 所有模型权重和评分协议均保持固定，未进行任务特定的微调。

paragraphs.en: Encoders were selected by predefined criteria independent of observed human alignment to represent standard anchors (ResNet-50, CLIP, and DINOv2), diverse pretraining objectives, varying model scales (0.024B–8.145B parameters), and within-family scaling pairs (e.g., Qwen3-VL-Embedding 2B vs. 8B, PE-Core B/16 vs. G/14). The resulting pool consists of 12 frozen encoders spanning supervised classification (ResNet-50; He et al., 2016 ), self-supervised visual representation learning (DINOv2, DINOv3; Oquab et al., 2024 ; Siméoni et al., 2026 ), and contrastive image–language alignment (CLIP, SigLIP 2, PE-Core, Jina CLIP v2; Radford et al., 2021 ; Tschannen et al., 2025 ; Bolya et al., 2025 ; Koukounas et al., 2024 ). Qwen3-VL-Embedding provides a multimodal embedding baseline trained for representation extraction, using the representation of the last valid input token ( Li et al., 2026 ).
paragraphs.zh: 编码器是根据预先设定的标准选择的，这些标准与观察到的人类对齐无关，旨在代表标准锚点（ResNet-50、CLIP 和 DINOv2），涵盖多样化的预训练目标、不同的模型规模（参数量为 0.024B–8.145B）以及同一模型家族内的缩放对比对（例如 Qwen3-VL-Embedding 2B 与 8B，PE-Core B/16 与 G/14）。 最终选定的编码器集合包含 12 个冻结编码器，涵盖监督分类（ResNet-50；He 等人，2016）、自监督视觉表示学习（DINOv2、DINOv3；Oquab 等人，2024；Siméoni 等人，2026）以及对比图像–语言对齐（CLIP、SigLIP 2、PE-Core、Jina CLIP v2；Radford 等人，2021；Tschannen 等人，2025；Bolya 等人，2025；Koukounas 等人，2024）。 Qwen3-VL-Embedding 提供了一个多模态嵌入基线模型，该模型经过训练以进行表示提取，并使用最后一个有效输入标记的表示（Li 等人，2026）。

sents.en: Encoders were selected by predefined criteria independent of observed human alignment to represent standard anchors (ResNet-50, CLIP, and DINOv2), diverse pretraining objectives, varying model scales (0.024B–8.145B parameters), and within-family scaling pairs (e.g., Qwen3-VL-Embedding 2B vs. 8B, PE-Core B/16 vs. G/14).
sents.zh: 编码器是根据预先设定的标准选择的，这些标准与观察到的人类对齐无关，旨在代表标准锚点（ResNet-50、CLIP 和 DINOv2），涵盖多样化的预训练目标、不同的模型规模（参数量为 0.024B–8.145B）以及同一模型家族内的缩放对比对（例如 Qwen3-VL-Embedding 2B 与 8B，PE-Core B/16 与 G/14）。

sents.en: The resulting pool consists of 12 frozen encoders spanning supervised classification (ResNet-50; He et al., 2016 ), self-supervised visual representation learning (DINOv2, DINOv3; Oquab et al., 2024 ; Siméoni et al., 2026 ), and contrastive image–language alignment (CLIP, SigLIP 2, PE-Core, Jina CLIP v2; Radford et al., 2021 ; Tschannen et al., 2025 ; Bolya et al., 2025 ; Koukounas et al., 2024 ).
sents.zh: 最终选定的编码器集合包含 12 个冻结编码器，涵盖监督分类（ResNet-50；He 等人，2016）、自监督视觉表示学习（DINOv2、DINOv3；Oquab 等人，2024；Siméoni 等人，2026）以及对比图像–语言对齐（CLIP、SigLIP 2、PE-Core、Jina CLIP v2；Radford 等人，2021；Tschannen 等人，2025；Bolya 等人，2025；Koukounas 等人，2024）。

sents.en: Qwen3-VL-Embedding provides a multimodal embedding baseline trained for representation extraction, using the representation of the last valid input token ( Li et al., 2026 ).

sents.zh: 下面，我们将说明如何在三个结构组中提取表示：使用直接全局池化或未投影类别标记的模型（ResNet-50、CLIP 和 PE-Core）；通过空间匹配块-标记距离进行评估的模型（DINOv2 和 DINOv3）；以及使用终端池化、投影或归一化变换的模型（SigLIP 2、Jina CLIP v2 和 Qwen3-VL-Embedding）。

paragraphs.en: ResNet-50 uses spatial global average pooling after each of its 16 bottleneck blocks, without the classification head. CLIP uses the block’s unprojected [CLS] token, without the terminal LayerNorm or projection. This choice follows the default unnormalized intermediate-feature convention in OpenCLIP, while retaining the original OpenAI CLIP checkpoint. PE-Core uses the spatial mean of block tokens after excluding prefix tokens, without terminal normalization or attention pooling. The PE feature API exposes unnormalized intermediate tokens; their spatial averaging is our fixed aggregation choice. Pooling rules therefore follow the native token structure of each architecture.
paragraphs.zh: ResNet-50 在其 16 个瓶颈块中的每个块之后都使用空间全局平均池化，且没有分类头。 CLIP 使用该块未经投影的 [CLS] 标记，且没有终端的 LayerNorm 或投影层。 这一选择遵循 OpenCLIP 中未经归一化的中间特征默认惯例，同时保留了原始的 OpenAI CLIP 检查点。 PE-Core 在排除前缀标记后使用块标记的空间均值，且没有终端归一化或注意力池化。 PE 特征 API 提供了未经归一化的中间标记；对其执行空间平均是我们固定的聚合方式。 因此，池化规则遵循每种架构的原生标记结构。

sents.zh: 因此，池化规则遵循每种架构的原生标记结构。

paragraphs.en: For DINOv2 and DINOv3, we apply the pretrained terminal LayerNorm to each candidate block, following the normalized intermediate-feature convention. We then exclude the leading [CLS] token and, for DINOv3, four register tokens. The score is the mean one-minus-cosine distance between corresponding spatial patch tokens. Tokens are not averaged before computing cosine distance, and no self-supervised projection head is used. This preserves a spatially matched comparison under the controlled original–modified pairing.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 DINOv2 和 DINOv3，我们遵循归一化中间特征惯例，将预训练的终端 LayerNorm 应用于每个候选块。 接着，我们排除开头的 [CLS] 标记，而对于 DINOv3，还排除四个寄存器标记。 得分是相应空间分块标记之间“1减余弦距离”的平均值。 在计算余弦距离之前，这些标记不会被取平均，且不使用任何自监督投影头。 这样可以在受控的原始-修改配对下，保持空间上的匹配比较。

paragraphs.en: SigLIP 2 applies its pretrained terminal LayerNorm and learned attention pooling to each block. Jina CLIP v2 applies its terminal normalization, [CLS] extraction, and projection. Qwen3-VL-Embedding processes images through its full visual tower into a multimodal language decoder (28 blocks for 2B, 36 for 8B). Following its official representation extraction protocol, we apply terminal RMSNorm and ℓ 2 \ell_{2} normalization to the representation of the last valid input token at each decoder block. Both Qwen models use the fixed default instruction “Represent the user’s input.” without task-specific prompting. These transformations are applied directly to intermediate blocks without retraining.
paragraphs.zh: SigLIP 2 将其预训练的终端 LayerNorm 和已学习的注意力池化应用于每个块。 Jina CLIP v2 应用其终端归一化、[CLS] 提取和投影。 Qwen3-VL-Embedding 通过其完整的视觉塔处理图像，并将其输入多模态语言解码器（2B 模型有 28 个块，8B 模型有 36 个块）。 遵循其官方的表示提取协议，我们在每个解码器块中对最后一个有效输入标记的表示应用终端 RMSNorm 和 ℓ₂ 归一化。 两款 Qwen 模型均使用固定的默认指令“表示用户的输入”，且未使用任务特定的提示。 这些转换直接应用于中间块，无需重新训练。

paragraphs.en: To identify the strongest representations achievable by each architecture, we evaluated pair distances across all 314 intermediate backbone blocks alongside each model’s default final output (e.g., CLIP’s projected embedding or PE-Core’s attention-pooled vector). For each task, the representative layer reported in Table S2 was selected by maximizing the signed Pearson correlation with human judgment differences across all stimulus pairs. The downstream protocol for incorporating these selected layers and top-performing models into partial correlation analyses is described in Appendix E.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了确定每种架构所能达到的最强表示，我们评估了所有 314 个中间主干块之间的成对距离，以及每个模型默认的最终输出（例如，CLIP 的投影嵌入或 PE-Core 的注意力池化向量）。 对于每个任务，表 S2 中报告的代表性层是通过最大化与所有刺激对之间人类判断差异的带符号皮尔逊相关性而选出的。 将这些选定的层和表现最佳的模型纳入部分相关性分析的下游协议在附录 E.3 中有详细说明。

paragraphs.en: Specifically, PSNR is computed from pixel-level mean squared error; SSIM evaluates local luminance, contrast, and structure over sliding windows; VIF models visual information fidelity in the wavelet domain; LPIPS-VGG computes ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -distance across five intermediate VGG-16 feature activation layers weighted by BAPPS perceptual judgments; and DISTS evaluates multi-scale structural and texture similarities using spatial deep features.
paragraphs.zh: 具体而言，PSNR 基于像素级的均方误差计算；SSIM 在滑动窗口上评估局部亮度、对比度和结构；VIF 在小波域中模拟视觉信息保真度；LPIPS-VGG 通过五个中间 VGG-16 特征激活层计算 ℓ₂ -距离，并由 BAPPS 感知判断进行加权；而 DISTS 则利用空间深度特征评估多尺度结构和纹理的相似性。

paragraphs.en: This section provides methodological details for the statistical inference, reliability estimation, and baseline partial correlation analysis reported in the main text.
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍了正文中报告的统计推断、可靠性估计以及基线偏相关分析的方法细节。

paragraphs.en: To account for sampling uncertainty across both observers and stimuli, primary human-dependent estimates (such as model–human alignment and human violation sensitivity) are evaluated via a nonparametric two-factor bootstrap ( 10,000 10{,}000 draws with fixed random seeds), independently resampling participants and base scenes with replacement. Participants are sampled within each stimulus-assignment group at their original sample sizes. Stimuli are sampled at the level of base scenes: Thatcher stimuli were resampled across the 140 140 face identities (keeping upright and inverted pairs together); Illumination stimuli were resampled at the level of the 48 48 base configurations within each operation, keeping horizontally mirrored variants together. Generative-model sensitivities do not depend on human ratings and are evaluated using base-scene resampling alone. In each iteration, condition means and the task-wide standard deviation denominator ( s m , task s_{m,\mathrm{task}} ) are recomputed dynamically, propagating scaling uncertainty into the resulting estimates. Identical bootstrap draws are shared across all models, conditions, and paired comparisons within each task. Pointwise 95% confidence intervals correspond to the empirical 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles across draws, summarizing sampling variability across observers and stimuli.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解释观察者和刺激之间的抽样不确定性，主要依赖人类的估计值（例如模型与人类的一致性以及对人类违规的敏感度）通过非参数双因素自助法进行评估（10,000次抽取，固定随机种子），并独立地有放回地重新抽样参与者和基础场景。 在每个刺激分配组内，按照其原始样本规模对参与者进行抽样。 刺激在基础场景层面进行抽样：Thatcher刺激从140个面部身份中重新抽样（保持直立和倒置成对出现）；Illumination刺激则在每个操作内的48种基础配置层面重新抽样（保持水平镜像变体一同出现）。 生成模型敏感度不依赖于人类评分，仅通过基础场景的重新抽样进行评估。 在每次迭代中，条件均值和任务范围内的标准差分母（s_m, task）都会被动态重新计算，从而将缩放不确定性传播到最终的估计值中。 在所有模型、条件和每个任务内的成对比较中，共享完全相同的自助法抽取结果。 逐点95%置信区间对应于各次抽取结果中的经验第2.5百分位和第97.5百分位，用于总结观察者和刺激之间的抽样变异性。

paragraphs.en: To test whether Generative scores retain human-aligned variation beyond strong frozen encoders and quality metrics, we compare the 25 Generative scores with the 12-encoder pool and the two prespecified five-metric IQA batteries described in Section 3.4 and Appendix D .
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验生成性分数是否在强大的冻结编码器和质量指标之外仍保留与人类对齐的变异性，我们将 25 个生成性分数与 12 个编码器池以及第 3.4 节和附录 D 中描述的两种预指定的五个指标组成的 IQA 电池进行比较。

paragraphs.en: To compare generative models against the strongest non-generative baselines, top-performing models are selected in two steps. First, for each of the 12 frozen encoders, we identify the layer that achieves the highest Pearson correlation with human unnaturalness ratings across the full task (Table S2 ). Second, from the 25 generative models and the 12 selected-layer encoders, we rank models by their correlation with human ratings and retain the top five from each pool. All five metrics in each IQA battery are retained without selection. These selected top-five models and encoder layers are held constant across all analyses within each task, including the condition breakdowns and factor profiles (Appendix I ), ensuring that differences across conditions reflect stimulus properties rather than shifts in model composition.
paragraphs.zh: 为了将生成模型与最强的非生成基线模型进行比较，我们分两步选择表现最佳的模型。 首先，对于每个 12 个冻结编码器，我们确定在整个任务中（表 S2）与人类对不自然性的评分相关性最高的层。 其次，从 25 个生成模型和 12 个已选层的编码器中，我们根据模型与人类评分的相关性进行排序，并从每个集合中保留排名前五的模型。 每个 IQA 测试包中的所有五个指标均被完整保留，无需筛选。 这些选定的前五大模型和编码器层在所有任务分析中保持不变，包括条件分解和因子分布（附录 I），从而确保不同条件之间的差异反映的是刺激特性，而非模型构成的变化。

paragraphs.en: Generative model loss is heavily sensitive to low-level image complexity and high-frequency statistics ( Nalisnick et al., 2019 ; Serrà et al., 2020 ) . Consequently, paired loss differences ( L modified − L original L_{\mathrm{modified}}-L_{\mathrm{original}} ) fail to track perceptual naturalness whenever an intervention alters these low-level properties, and unconditioned standalone losses fail to reflect human ratings across differing visual compositions. To evaluate the necessity of content-preserving relational manipulations and paired score differencing, we conducted two diagnostic evaluations: generic low-level distortions alongside element deletion, and standalone single-image loss evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: 生成模型损失对低层图像复杂度和高频统计量极为敏感（Nalisnick 等人，2019；Serrà 等人，2020）。 因此，当干预措施改变这些低层属性时，成对损失差异（L_{\mathrm{modified}}-L_{\mathrm{original}}）无法反映感知上的自然性，而未条件化的独立损失也无法在不同视觉构图下体现人类评分。 为了评估内容保留型关系操作和成对得分差异的必要性，我们进行了两项诊断性评估：通用低层失真与元素删除测试，以及针对单张图像的独立损失评估。

paragraphs.en: To test these limitations, we evaluated paired model loss under two scenarios: generic low-level distortions on the CSIQ benchmark ( Larson & Chandler, 2010 ) and element deletion in synthetic 3D scenes (Figure S10 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验这些局限性，我们在两种场景下评估了成对模型损失：CSIQ基准测试（Larson & Chandler, 2010）中的通用低级失真，以及合成3D场景中的元素删除（图S10）。

paragraphs.en: First, we tested whether loss differences relative to the reference image ( L distorted − L reference L_{\mathrm{distorted}}-L_{\mathrm{reference}} ) track human quality judgments across standard corruptions using the CSIQ benchmark ( Larson & Chandler, 2010 ) (Figure S10 A). We restricted this evaluation to pixel-space diffusion models (three JiT variants, PixelGen 512, and HiDream-O1-Image) to avoid confounding generative priors with VAE compression characteristics. Evaluating loss–DMOS correlations within each distortion type reveals a severe statistical bias (Figure S10 B). For distortions that add high-frequency variance (AWGN and pink noise), model loss correlates positively with perceived degradation. In contrast, for distortions that smooth textures or attenuate contrast (blur, JPEG, JPEG 2000, and contrast reduction), the correlation systematically reverses to negative. Because denoising objectives naturally penalize high-frequency variance while favoring smoother images, paired loss differences cannot overcome unconstrained shifts in low-level statistics, rendering native loss ineffective as a general-purpose quality metric.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，我们使用 CSIQ 基准（Larson & Chandler, 2010）测试了相对于参考图像的损失差异（L_{\mathrm{distorted}}-L_{\mathrm{reference}}）是否在标准失真类型上能够反映人类的质量判断（图 S10 A）。 我们将此评估限制在像素空间的扩散模型上（三种 JiT 变体、PixelGen 512 和 HiDream-O1-Image），以避免生成先验与 VAE 压缩特性相互混淆。 对每种失真类型中损失与 DMOS 的相关性进行评估，揭示了严重的统计偏差（图 S10 B）。 对于添加高频方差的失真（AWGN 和粉噪），模型损失与感知到的质量下降呈正相关。 相比之下，对于平滑纹理或减弱对比度的失真（模糊、JPEG、JPEG 2000 和对比度降低），这种相关性则系统性地反转为负值。 由于去噪目标天然会惩罚高频方差而偏好更平滑的图像，配对损失差异无法克服低层统计量的无约束变化，这使得原生损失无法作为通用的质量度量指标。

sents.en: First, we tested whether loss differences relative to the reference image ( L distorted − L reference L_{\mathrm{distorted}}-L_{\mathrm{reference}} ) track human quality judgments across standard corruptions using the CSIQ benchmark ( Larson & Chandler, 2010 ) (Figure S10 A).
sents.zh: 首先，我们使用 CSIQ 基准（Larson & Chandler, 2010）测试了相对于参考图像的损失差异（L_{\mathrm{distorted}}-L_{\mathrm{reference}}）是否在标准失真类型上能够反映人类的质量判断（图 S10 A）。

sents.en: Evaluating loss–DMOS correlations within each distortion type reveals a severe statistical bias (Figure S10 B).
sents.zh: 对每种失真类型中损失与 DMOS 的相关性进行评估，揭示了严重的统计偏差（图 S10 B）。

sents.en: For distortions that add high-frequency variance (AWGN and pink noise), model loss correlates positively with perceived degradation.
sents.zh: 对于添加高频方差的失真（AWGN 和粉噪），模型损失与感知到的质量下降呈正相关。

sents.en: In contrast, for distortions that smooth textures or attenuate contrast (blur, JPEG, JPEG 2000, and contrast reduction), the correlation systematically reverses to negative.

paragraphs.en: Second, we examined whether altering image content undermines the evaluation of physical consistency. Using 96 rendered 3D scenes, we compared model responses under two shadow manipulations (Figure S10 C): (1) one-shadow deletion , which removes a cast shadow entirely, introducing a physical anomaly while reducing overall image complexity; and (2) shadow swap (our main paradigm), which relocates shadows between objects, creating physical inconsistency while preserving low-level image statistics.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，我们研究了改变图像内容是否会损害对物理一致性的评估。 我们使用 96 个渲染出的 3D 场景，比较了模型在两种阴影操作下的响应（图 S10 C）：(1) 单阴影删除，即完全移除一个投射的阴影，从而引入物理异常，同时降低图像的整体复杂性；以及 (2) 阴影交换（我们的主要范式），即将阴影在不同物体之间重新定位，从而制造出物理不一致性，但保留了低层图像统计特征。

sents.en: Second, we examined whether altering image content undermines the evaluation of physical consistency.
sents.zh: 其次，我们研究了改变图像内容是否会损害对物理一致性的评估。

sents.en: Using 96 rendered 3D scenes, we compared model responses under two shadow manipulations (Figure S10 C): (1) one-shadow deletion , which removes a cast shadow entirely, introducing a physical anomaly while reducing overall image complexity; and (2) shadow swap (our main paradigm), which relocates shadows between objects, creating physical inconsistency while preserving low-level image statistics.
sents.zh: 我们使用 96 个渲染出的 3D 场景，比较了模型在两种阴影操作下的响应（图 S10 C）：(1) 单阴影删除，即完全移除一个投射的阴影，从而引入物理异常，同时降低图像的整体复杂性；以及 (2) 阴影交换（我们的主要范式），即将阴影在不同物体之间重新定位，从而制造出物理不一致性，但保留了低层图像统计特征。

paragraphs.en: Standardized loss differences (defined for this control as the mean paired loss difference divided by the sample standard deviation over the 96 pairs) show distinct patterns between the two manipulations (Figure S10 D). For one-shadow deletion, loss changes were uniformly negative across all models: although removing a shadow makes the scene physically unnatural, the reduced image complexity dominates the loss landscape, causing the model to evaluate the corrupted scene as more probable. In contrast, under shadow swap, preserving low-level statistics mitigates this negative artifact, allowing more capable architectures to exhibit positive loss penalties that reflect sensitivity to the physical inconsistency.
paragraphs.zh: 标准化损失差异（在此控制实验中定义为平均配对损失差异除以 96 对样本的标准差）在两种操作之间显示出不同的模式（图 S10 D）。 对于单阴影删除，所有模型中的损失变化均为负值：尽管移除阴影会使场景在物理上显得不自然，但图像复杂性的降低主导了损失景观，导致模型认为被破坏的场景更有可能发生。 相比之下，在阴影交换的情况下，保留低层统计信息可以减轻这种负面伪影，使能力更强的架构能够表现出正的损失惩罚，从而反映对物理不一致性的敏感性。

paragraphs.en: Across individual conditions, generative models consistently retained positive residual correlations with human judgments ( r ⁡ ( h , G ∣ X ) r(h,G\mid X) ) after controlling for each non-generative baseline (Figure S14 , bottom panels). For upright faces, cast shadows, and light direction, generative scores accounted for substantial human-aligned variance beyond visual encoders and standard quality metrics, whereas baseline residual associations were comparatively low. Under face inversion, residual correlations were attenuated for both generative models and baselines, consistent with the overall reduction in perceptual sensitivity. For surface reflections, both generative models and visual encoders retained positive residual associations ( r ⁡ ( h , G ∣ Encoder ) ≈ .346 r(h,G\mid\mathrm{Encoder})\approx.346 , r ⁡ ( h , Encoder ∣ G ) ≈ .584 r(h,\mathrm{Encoder}\mid G)\approx.584 ), indicating that both representations capture distinct aspects of reflection naturalness.
paragraphs.zh: 在各个实验条件下，在控制了每种非生成性基线模型之后（图 S14，底部面板），生成模型与人类判断之间始终保持着正向的残差相关性（r(h,G\mid X)）。 对于正立人脸、投射阴影和光照方向，生成模型的得分能够解释大量与人类判断一致的变化，这种变化是视觉编码器和标准质量指标无法捕捉的，而基线模型的残差关联则相对较低。 在人脸倒置条件下，生成模型和基线模型的残差相关性均有所减弱，这与感知敏感性的整体下降相一致。 对于表面反射，生成模型和视觉编码器都保持了正向的残差关联（r(h,G\mid\mathrm{Encoder})\approx.346，r(h,\mathrm{Encoder}\mid G)\approx.584），表明这两种表示都捕捉到了反射自然性的不同方面。

paragraphs.en: While overall evaluations measure aggregate alignment across the full stimulus set, they obscure which specific scene properties accompany human–model consistency or divergence. We therefore examined how perceived unnaturalness and model predictions vary across the object shapes, rotations, colors, and physical parameters of the Illumination stimuli (Appendix A ). We evaluate the task-pooled top-five models (Section 3.4 ): generative models Wan2.1 T2V 14B, Qwen-Image, Wan2.2 T2V A14B, Qwen-Image-2512, and HunyuanVideo (Table S1 ); and encoders PE-Core B/16, PE-Core G/14, CLIP ViT-B/16, SigLIP 2 Base/16, and Jina CLIP v2 (Table S3 ). All five metrics from each IQA battery are also retained. The same model sets are used in the condition-level comparison in Figure S14 .
paragraphs.zh: 虽然整体评估衡量了完整刺激集上的综合一致性，但它们掩盖了哪些特定的场景属性与人类和模型之间的一致性或分歧相关。 因此，我们研究了感知到的不自然感以及模型预测在 Illumination 刺激的物体形状、旋转、颜色和物理参数（附录 A）中如何变化。 我们评估了任务池中的前五个模型（第 3.4 节）：生成模型 Wan2.1 T2V 14B、Qwen-Image、Wan2.2 T2V A14B、Qwen-Image-2512 和 HunyuanVideo（表 S1）；以及编码器 PE-Core B/16、PE-Core G/14、CLIP ViT-B/16、SigLIP 2 Base/16 和 Jina CLIP v2（表 S3）。 每个 IQA 电池中的全部五个指标也被保留。 图 S14 中的条件级别比较也使用了相同的模型集。

paragraphs.en: Human sensitivity to inconsistencies was strongly modulated by object geometry. In both cast shadows and surface reflections, rotating objects with distinct, familiar axes produced highly salient unnaturalness: Shadow scores reached 0.714 0.714 for the torus and 1.462 1.462 for the teapot (S2), while Spot cow rotations in Reflection elicited similarly marked unnaturalness ( 1.145 1.145 and 1.540 1.540 ; R2). In Shadow, unnaturalness for the Spot cow was much higher when rotations introduced salient 2D contour asymmetry ( 45 ∘ ↔ 90 ∘ 45^{\circ}\leftrightarrow 90^{\circ} : 0.973 0.973 ) than when the 2D silhouette was near mirror-symmetric ( − 45 ∘ ↔ 135 ∘ -45^{\circ}\leftrightarrow 135^{\circ} : 0.170 0.170 ). In contrast, rotating the complex torus knot produced negligible perceived unnaturalness in both Shadow ( − 0.077 -0.077 and 0.013 0.013 ) and Reflection ( 0.018 0.018 and 0.089 0.089 ). Similarly, in Light direction (L1), mirroring the central sphere elicited strong unnaturalness ( 1.805 1.805 ), whereas the same manipulation on the torus knot was virtually unnoticed ( 0.014 0.014 ). Generative models closely tracked this selective sensitivity across both shadows and reflections (median MSE = 0.061 \mathrm{MSE}=0.061 in Shadow rotation, 0.324 0.324 in Reflection rotation, and 0.170 0.170 in Light direction; Figure S15 ). As shown in Figures S16 – S18 , generative scores reproduced the distinction between subtle torus-knot rotations and conspicuous teapot or Spot rotations in both shadow and reflection, as well as the difference between the symmetric and asymmetric Spot shadow configurations. Visual encoders ( MSE = 0.418 \mathrm{MSE}=0.418 – 0.632 0.632 ) and FR-IQA metrics ( 0.645 0.645 – 1.058 1.058 ), by contrast, showed larger discrepancies, responding strongly to torus-knot rotations and lighting changes despite human judgments being near baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 人类对不一致性的感知受到物体几何形状的强烈调节。 在投射阴影和表面反射两种情况下，旋转具有清晰且熟悉轴线的物体都会产生非常显著的异常感：对于环面，阴影评分达到 0.714 0.714；对于茶壶（S2），则达到 1.462 1.462。而在反射中，Spot 牛的旋转也引发了同样明显的异常感（1.145 1.145 和 1.540 1.540；R2）。 在阴影中，当旋转导致明显的二维轮廓不对称性时（45° ↔ 90° 45^{\circ}\leftrightarrow 90^{\circ}：0.973 0.973），Spot 牛产生的异常感远高于二维剪影接近镜像对称时的情形（−45° ↔ 135° -45^{\circ}\leftrightarrow 135^{\circ}：0.170 0.170）。 相比之下，旋转复杂的环面结在阴影（−0.077 -0.077 和 0.013 0.013）和反射（0.018 0.018 和 0.089 0.089）中几乎未引发任何可感知的异常感。 同样，在光照方向（L1）中，对中心球体进行镜像处理引发了强烈的异常感（1.805 1.805），而对环面结进行同样的操作却几乎未被察觉（0.014 0.014）。 生成模型在阴影和反射两种情况下都紧密追踪了这种选择性的感知敏感性（中位数 MSE = 0.061 \mathrm{MSE}=0.061，阴影旋转；0.324 0.324，反射旋转；以及 0.170 0.170，光照方向；图 S15）。 如图 S16–S18 所示，生成模型在阴影和反射中均再现了细微的环面结旋转与显著的茶壶或 Spot 旋转之间的差异，以及 Spot 阴影配置中对称与不对称状态之间的区别。 相比之下，视觉编码器（MSE = 0.418 \mathrm{MSE}=0.418–0.632 0.632）和 FR-IQA 指标（0.645 0.645–1.058 1.058）则表现出更大的差异，尽管人类的判断接近基线水平，但它们对环面结的旋转和光照变化仍作出了强烈反应。

paragraphs.en: In contrast to rotation, human judgments of shape swaps showed consistently salient unnaturalness across all tested pairs in both Shadow (S1: 1.261 1.261 – 1.913 1.913 ) and Reflection (R1: 1.784 1.784 – 2.155 2.155 ). Generative models failed to capture this uniform human intolerance: rather than remaining consistently high, median generative scores varied widely across object geometries in both Shadow ( 0.711 0.711 for Torus ↔ \leftrightarrow gear to 2.597 2.597 for Teapot ↔ \leftrightarrow Spot) and Reflection ( 0.761 0.761 for Cube ↔ \leftrightarrow sphere to 2.789 2.789 for Teapot ↔ \leftrightarrow Spot; Figures S16 – S17 ). A distinct profile divergence also appeared for reflection color shifts (R3). Whereas human observers judged subtle hue discrepancies as already markedly unnatural ( 1.730 1.730 on Cube, 2.052 2.052 on Torus) with only modest increases for large shifts ( 2.247 2.247 and 2.416 2.416 ), generative models scaled strongly with the magnitude of chromatic discrepancy—remaining largely insensitive to subtle hue deviations ( 0.480 0.480 and 0.431 0.431 ) but surging for large shifts (reaching 2.479 2.479 on Cube). This contrast between threshold-like human sensitivity and continuous, magnitude-scaling generative losses produced the largest generative profile error across all factors (median MSE = 1.292 \mathrm{MSE}=1.292 vs. encoder 1.037 1.037 ). In Reflection shape swaps (R1) as well, encoders aligned more closely with uniform human elevations ( MSE = 0.456 \mathrm{MSE}=0.456 vs. generative 0.753 0.753 ). These factor-level discrepancies suggest why visual encoders retained substantial residual predictive power specifically for surface reflections (Figure S14 ).
paragraphs.zh: 与旋转不同，人类对形状交换的判断在所有测试的成对中均表现出显著的不自然感，无论是在阴影（S1：1.261 – 1.913）还是在反射（R1：1.784 – 2.155）条件下。 生成模型未能捕捉到这种一致的人类排斥反应：与保持持续高位不同，生成得分的中位数在不同物体几何结构中差异显著，无论是在阴影（环面 ↔ 齿轮的得分为 0.711，茶壶 ↔ 点光源的得分为 2.597）还是在反射（立方体 ↔ 球体的得分为 0.761，茶壶 ↔ 点光源的得分为 2.789；图 S16 – S17）条件下。 在反射颜色变化（R3）中也出现了明显的特征分布差异。 人类观察者认为细微的颜色差异就已经明显不自然（立方体上为 1.730，环面上为 2.052），而较大颜色变化仅带来轻微的增加（分别为 2.247 和 2.416）；相比之下，生成模型对色度差异的幅度表现出强烈的依赖性——对细微的颜色偏差基本不敏感（分别为 0.480 和 0.431），但在较大变化时得分急剧上升（在立方体上达到 2.479）。 这种类似阈值的人类感知灵敏度与连续且随幅度变化的生成损失之间的对比，导致在所有因素中出现了最大的生成特征分布误差（MSE 中位数为 1.292，而编码器的 MSE 为 1.037）。 在反射形状交换（R1）中，编码器也与一致的人类评分更为接近（MSE = 0.456，而生成模型的 MSE 为 0.753）。 这些因素层面的差异表明，视觉编码器为何能保留对表面反射特有的显著预测能力（图 S14）。

sents.zh: 这种类似阈值的人类感知灵敏度与连续且随幅度变化的生成损失之间的对比，导致在所有因素中出现了最大的生成特征分布误差（MSE 中位数为 1.292，而编码器的 MSE 为 1.037）。

sents.en: In Reflection shape swaps (R1) as well, encoders aligned more closely with uniform human elevations ( MSE = 0.456 \mathrm{MSE}=0.456 vs. generative 0.753 0.753 ).
sents.zh: 在反射形状交换（R1）中，编码器也与一致的人类评分更为接近（MSE = 0.456，而生成模型的 MSE 为 0.753）。

sents.en: These factor-level discrepancies suggest why visual encoders retained substantial residual predictive power specifically for surface reflections (Figure S14 ).
sents.zh: 这些因素层面的差异表明，视觉编码器为何能保留对表面反射特有的显著预测能力（图 S14）。

paragraphs.en: Physical scene parameters also systematically affected human judgments and model predictions. In cast shadows, human perceived unnaturalness was higher for hard than soft shadows (S4: 1.731 1.731 vs. 0.400 0.400 ) and when objects were placed near the ground (S3: 1.224 1.224 vs. 0.908 0.908 ). Generative models closely tracked both contrasts (median MSE = 0.043 \mathrm{MSE}=0.043 for softness and 0.011 0.011 for height), whereas visual encoders exhibited larger errors ( 0.922 0.922 and 0.530 0.530 ). Similarly, in surface reflections, human ratings decreased from smooth to rough floors (R5: 2.166 2.166 vs. 1.054 1.054 ) and from low to high object positions (R4: 1.773 1.773 vs. 1.447 1.447 ). All model classes captured these reductions with comparable accuracy ( MSE ≈ 0.09 \mathrm{MSE}\approx 0.09 – 0.18 0.18 ). In Light direction, human perceived unnaturalness for lighting inconsistencies was higher on diffuse than metallic surfaces (L2: 1.063 1.063 vs. 0.675 0.675 ) and higher for lateral lighting ( 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} ) than overhead lighting ( 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} ; L4: 1.001 1.001 vs. 0.736 0.736 ), contrasts that generative models matched with low error ( MSE ≤ 0.035 \mathrm{MSE}\leq 0.035 ). Finally, for object height in Light direction (L3), height also determined whether floor cast shadows were rendered as a reference cue (present at low height, disabled at high height; Appendix A ). In this condition, human ratings showed little difference between heights ( 0.850 0.850 vs. 0.887 0.887 ), whereas generative models scored higher when cast shadows were present ( 1.070 1.070 vs. 0.615 0.615 , median MSE = 0.104 \mathrm{MSE}=0.104 ; Figure S18 ).
paragraphs.zh: 物理场景参数也系统性地影响了人类的判断和模型预测。 在投射阴影中，人类感知到的不自然程度在硬阴影中高于软阴影（S4：1.731 1.731 vs. 0.400 0.400），并且在物体靠近地面时更高（S3：1.224 1.224 vs. 0.908 0.908）。 生成模型紧密追踪了这两种对比（软度方面中位数 MSE = 0.043 \mathrm{MSE}=0.043，高度方面为 0.011 0.011），而视觉编码器则表现出更大的误差（0.922 0.922 和 0.530 0.530）。 类似地，在表面反射中，人类评分从光滑地板到粗糙地板时降低（R5：2.166 2.166 vs. 1.054 1.054），并从物体低位置到高位置时降低（R4：1.773 1.773 vs. 1.447 1.447）。 所有模型类别都以相当高的准确性捕捉到了这些下降（MSE ≈ 0.09 \mathrm{MSE}\approx 0.09 – 0.18 0.18）。 在光照方向中，对于光照不一致性，人类感知到的不自然程度在漫反射表面高于金属表面（L2：1.063 1.063 vs. 0.675 0.675），并且在侧向光照（30 ∘ 30^{\circ}）中高于顶向光照（15 ∘ 15^{\circ}；L4：1.001 1.001 vs. 0.736 0.736）；生成模型以低误差（MSE ≤ 0.035 \mathrm{MSE}\leq 0.035）匹配了这些对比。 最后，在光照方向中的物体高度（L3），高度也决定了地板投射的阴影是否被渲染为参考线索（低高度时存在，高高度时禁用；附录 A）。 在此条件下，人类评分在不同高度之间差异很小（0.850 0.850 vs. 0.887 0.887），而生成模型在存在投射阴影时得分更高（1.070 1.070 vs. 0.615 0.615，中位数 MSE = 0.104 \mathrm{MSE}=0.104；图 S18）。

paragraphs.en: We evaluated how violation sensitivity and human alignment relate to model capacity across the 25 generative models (Figure S19 ). For generative models, model size is defined as the parameter count of the denoising or flow backbone network used to compute native scores (ranging from 0.14B to 20B parameters).
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了违规敏感性和人类对齐性与模型容量之间的关系，涵盖 25 种生成模型（图 S19）。 对于生成模型，模型大小定义为用于计算原始得分的去噪或流主干网络的参数数量（范围从 0.14B 到 20B 个参数）。

sents.en: We evaluated how violation sensitivity and human alignment relate to model capacity across the 25 generative models (Figure S19 ).
sents.zh: 我们评估了违规敏感性和人类对齐性与模型容量之间的关系，涵盖 25 种生成模型（图 S19）。

sents.en: For generative models, model size is defined as the parameter count of the denoising or flow backbone network used to compute native scores (ranging from 0.14B to 20B parameters).
sents.zh: 对于生成模型，模型大小定义为用于计算原始得分的去噪或流主干网络的参数数量（范围从 0.14B 到 20B 个参数）。

paragraphs.en: Larger generators generally tended to show both stronger violation sensitivity and closer human alignment, though these associations varied across tasks and metrics. Log parameter count correlated positively with violation sensitivity (Thatcher: Pearson r = .741 r=.741 , Spearman ρ = .685 \rho=.685 ; Illumination: r = .831 r=.831 , ρ = .841 \rho=.841 ) and human alignment (Thatcher: r = .627 r=.627 , ρ = .375 \rho=.375 ; Illumination: r = .803 r=.803 , ρ = .796 \rho=.796 ). The weaker rank correlation for Thatcher alignment ( ρ = .375 \rho=.375 ) suggests that while larger models were generally more sensitive, human alignment did not follow model size equally closely across all evaluated models.
paragraphs.zh: 较大的生成器通常表现出更强的违规敏感性和更高的人类对齐度，尽管这些关联因任务和指标而异。 对数参数数量与违规敏感性（Thatcher：Pearson r = .741 r=.741，Spearman ρ = .685 \rho=.685；Illumination：r = .831 r=.831，ρ = .841 \rho=.841）以及人类对齐度（Thatcher：r = .627 r=.627，ρ = .375 \rho=.375；Illumination：r = .803 r=.803，ρ = .796 \rho=.796）呈正相关。 Thatcher 对齐度中较弱的秩相关（ρ = .375 \rho=.375）表明，尽管较大的模型通常更敏感，但人类对齐度并未在所有评估模型中都与模型大小保持同样紧密的关联。

paragraphs.en: To provide an empirical reference over an overlapping parameter range, we also evaluated all 12 frozen vision and multimodal encoders at the layer selected for each task (Table S2 ; 0.02B to 8.1B parameters; Figure S19 , open green diamonds). Encoder size denotes the full scoring network, not the prefix ending at the selected layer. The same standardization (mean feature distance divided by its standard deviation across the task) was applied to unsigned distances, which measure representational divergence rather than directional unnaturalness. At the selected layers, encoder sensitivity was moderately negatively associated with log parameter count on Thatcher and weakly associated on Illumination (Thatcher: r = − .308 r=-.308 , ρ = − .399 \rho=-.399 ; Illumination: r = .090 r=.090 , ρ = .028 \rho=.028 ). Encoder human alignment was positively associated with size on Thatcher ( r = .380 r=.380 , ρ = .322 \rho=.322 ), but weakly associated on Illumination ( r = − .110 r=-.110 , ρ = − .098 \rho=-.098 ). Thus, whereas larger generators show both stronger violation sensitivity and closer human alignment, scaling encoder size does not automatically improve either metric, particularly on Illumination.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在重叠的参数范围内提供经验参考，我们还评估了所有 12 种冻结的视觉和多模态编码器，在每个任务所选的层上进行评估（表 S2；0.02B 至 8.1B 个参数；图 S19，开放绿色菱形）。 编码器规模指的是完整的评分网络，而非以所选层为结尾的前缀部分。 对无符号距离应用了相同的标准化方法（特征均值距离除以该任务中的标准差），这些距离衡量的是表示差异，而非方向性的不自然性。 在所选层上，编码器的敏感性与参数数量的对数在 Thatcher 任务中呈中度负相关，在 Illumination 任务中则相关性较弱（Thatcher：r = − .308 r=-.308，ρ = − .399 \rho=-.399；Illumination：r = .090 r=.090，ρ = .028 \rho=.028）。 在 Thatcher 任务中，编码器与人类的对齐度与规模呈正相关（r = .380 r=.380，ρ = .322 \rho=.322），但在 Illumination 任务中相关性较弱（r = − .110 r=-.110，ρ = − .098 \rho=-.098）。 因此，尽管较大的生成器表现出更强的违规敏感性和更贴近人类的对齐度，但扩大编码器规模并不会自动提升这两项指标，尤其是在 Illumination 任务中。

paragraphs.en: Decomposing this relationship by stimulus condition (Figures S20 and S21 ) reveals that model capacity affects violation sensitivity and human alignment through distinct trajectories. Violation sensitivity scaled positively with parameter count across nearly all conditions (Thatcher upright: Pearson r = .760 , ρ = .694 r=.760,\rho=.694 ; inverted: r = .697 , ρ = .641 r=.697,\rho=.641 ; cast shadow: r = .790 , ρ = .846 r=.790,\rho=.846 ; surface reflection: r = .783 , ρ = .729 r=.783,\rho=.729 ; light direction: r = .244 , ρ = .191 r=.244,\rho=.191 ), indicating that larger backbones systematically acquire stronger penalties for relational alterations across diverse visual domains. In contrast, human alignment exhibited pronounced domain selectivity: while alignment scaled with capacity for cast shadows ( r = .649 , ρ = .688 r=.649,\rho=.688 ) and light direction ( r = .610 , ρ = .526 r=.610,\rho=.526 ), it showed no positive association with model size for surface reflections ( r = − .256 , ρ = − .104 r=-.256,\rho=-.104 ) and saturated early for upright faces ( r = .516 , ρ = .378 r=.516,\rho=.378 ).
paragraphs.zh: 通过刺激条件分解这种关系（图 S20 和 S21）可以发现，模型容量通过不同的路径影响对违规的敏感性和与人类的对齐程度。 在所有几乎全部条件下，违规敏感性都随着参数数量的增加而呈正相关增长（Thatcher 直立面部：Pearson r = .760，ρ = .694；倒置面部：r = .697，ρ = .641；投射阴影：r = .790，ρ = .846；表面反射：r = .783，ρ = .729；光照方向：r = .244，ρ = .191），这表明更大的模型主干在不同视觉领域中系统性地对关系变化产生了更强的惩罚。 相比之下，与人类的对齐程度表现出明显的领域选择性：虽然投射阴影（r = .649，ρ = .688）和光照方向（r = .610，ρ = .526）条件下对齐程度随模型容量增长而提升，但在表面反射条件下，对齐程度与模型规模没有正相关关系（r = −.256，ρ = −.0104），而在直立面部条件下则很早就达到了饱和（r = .516，ρ = .378）。

sents.en: Decomposing this relationship by stimulus condition (Figures S20 and S21 ) reveals that model capacity affects violation sensitivity and human alignment through distinct trajectories.

sents.en: Violation sensitivity scaled positively with parameter count across nearly all conditions (Thatcher upright: Pearson r = .760 , ρ = .694 r=.760,\rho=.694 ; inverted: r = .697 , ρ = .641 r=.697,\rho=.641 ; cast shadow: r = .790 , ρ = .846 r=.790,\rho=.846 ; surface reflection: r = .783 , ρ = .729 r=.783,\rho=.729 ; light direction: r = .244 , ρ = .191 r=.244,\rho=.191 ), indicating that larger backbones systematically acquire stronger penalties for relational alterations across diverse visual domains.
sents.zh: 在所有几乎全部条件下，违规敏感性都随着参数数量的增加而呈正相关增长（Thatcher 直立面部：Pearson r = .760，ρ = .694；倒置面部：r = .697，ρ = .641；投射阴影：r = .790，ρ = .846；表面反射：r = .783，ρ = .729；光照方向：r = .244，ρ = .191），这表明更大的模型主干在不同视觉领域中系统性地对关系变化产生了更强的惩罚。

sents.en: In contrast, human alignment exhibited pronounced domain selectivity: while alignment scaled with capacity for cast shadows ( r = .649 , ρ = .688 r=.649,\rho=.688 ) and light direction ( r = .610 , ρ = .526 r=.610,\rho=.526 ), it showed no positive association with model size for surface reflections ( r = − .256 , ρ = − .104 r=-.256,\rho=-.104 ) and saturated early for upright faces ( r = .516 , ρ = .378 r=.516,\rho=.378 ).
sents.zh: 相比之下，与人类的对齐程度表现出明显的领域选择性：虽然投射阴影（r = .649，ρ = .688）和光照方向（r = .610，ρ = .526）条件下对齐程度随模型容量增长而提升，但在表面反射条件下，对齐程度与模型规模没有正相关关系（r = −.256，ρ = −.0104），而在直立面部条件下则很早就达到了饱和（r = .516，ρ = .378）。

paragraphs.en: Crucially, the absence of alignment scaling for surface reflections cannot be attributed to human rating noise, as participants exhibited high split-half reliability in this condition ( r = .932 r=.932 ; Appendix E.2 ). Instead, it reflects a genuine divergence between the statistical features captured by generative loss minimization (which readily penalizes surface modifications) and the physical or perceptual criteria humans employ to judge reflection naturalness.
paragraphs.zh: 关键在于，表面反射缺乏对齐缩放的现象不能归因于人类评分的噪声，因为参与者在这一条件下表现出很高的半分割可靠性（r = .932 r=.932；附录 E.2）。 相反，这反映了生成性损失最小化所捕捉到的统计特征（该过程会轻易惩罚表面修改）与人类判断反射自然性时所用的物理或感知标准之间的真实差异。

sents.en: Instead, it reflects a genuine divergence between the statistical features captured by generative loss minimization (which readily penalizes surface modifications) and the physical or perceptual criteria humans employ to judge reflection naturalness.
sents.zh: 相反，这反映了生成性损失最小化所捕捉到的统计特征（该过程会轻易惩罚表面修改）与人类判断反射自然性时所用的物理或感知标准之间的真实差异。

paragraphs.en: We conducted a post-hoc comparison with published generation evaluations to ask whether models’ human alignment in our tasks is associated with broader generation performance, beyond what can be explained by overall violation sensitivity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们与已发表的生成评估进行了事后比较，旨在探究模型在我们任务中体现的人类对齐能力，是否与更广泛的生成性能相关——这种相关性无法仅通过整体违规敏感度来解释。

paragraphs.en: To control for sensitivity, we transformed Q Q , A A , and S S to average ranks within each image/video task panel, separately regressed the ranks of Q Q and A A on an intercept and the rank of S S , and correlated the two residuals using Pearson correlation, without reranking them. The resulting partial Spearman coefficients were .182 .182 and .670 .670 for image models and .900 .900 and .778 .778 for video models (Figure S23 ). Thus, positive associations remained on Illumination for image models and both tasks for video models, whereas the association on Thatcher for image models was weak.
paragraphs.zh: 为了控制敏感性，我们将 Q Q、A A 和 S S 转换为每个图像/视频任务面板内的平均排名，分别对 Q Q 和 A A 的排名与 S S 的排名进行回归分析，并使用皮尔逊相关系数对两个残差进行相关性分析，而不对它们重新排序。 由此得到的部分斯皮尔曼相关系数对于图像模型为 .182 和 .670，对于视频模型为 .900 和 .778（图 S23）。 因此，在光照任务中，图像模型仍表现出正相关；在视频模型中，两种任务均表现出正相关，而 Thatcher 任务中图像模型的相关性则较弱。

paragraphs.en: We also examined the reciprocal association by separately regressing the ranks of Q Q and S S on an intercept and the rank of A A , using the same matched models and residual-correlation procedure. Partial Spearman correlations were .201 .201 and − .045 -.045 for image models on Thatcher and Illumination, respectively, and .122 .122 and .218 .218 for video models (Table S5 ; Figure S24 ). These weak residual associations are consistent with the possibility that generation evaluations relate more to item-level human alignment than to overall violation sensitivity alone, although given the modest sample sizes, these observations should be viewed as preliminary.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还通过分别对 Q Q 和 S S 的秩进行回归分析，将其与截距项和 A A 的秩相关联，从而检验了这种相互关联；分析中使用了相同的匹配模型和残差相关性处理程序。 对于 Thatcher 和 Illumination 图像模型，部分 Spearman 相关系数分别为 .201、.201 和 −.045、−.045；对于视频模型，则分别为 .122、.122 和 .218、.218（表 S5；图 S24）。 这些较弱的残差关联表明，生成评估可能与项目层面的人类对齐更为相关，而不仅仅是与整体的违规敏感度有关；不过，鉴于样本量有限，这些观察结果应被视为初步结论。

paragraphs.en: As a supplementary check, we added scoring-backbone parameter count P P (Table S4 ) to the sensitivity adjustment. paragraphs.en: To compare trajectories across heterogeneous model architectures and noise schedulers, we define:
paragraphs.zh: 为了比较不同模型架构和噪声调度器下的轨迹，我们定义如下：

paragraphs.en: Normalized schedule coordinate: For a model with | T | |T| stored timesteps, discrete index j ∈ { 0 , … , | T | − 1 } j\in\{0,\dots,|T|-1\} is mapped to t norm = j / ( | T | − 1 ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] t_{\mathrm{norm}}=j/(|T|-1)\in[0,1] , where 0 0 denotes the earliest (maximum noise) step and 1 1 the final (minimum noise) step.
paragraphs.zh: 归一化调度坐标：对于一个存储了 | T | 个时间步的模型，离散索引 j ∈ { 0 , … , | T | − 1 } 被映射为 t norm = j / ( | T | − 1 ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ]，其中 0 表示最早（噪声最大）的时间步，而 1 表示最后（噪声最小）的时间步。

paragraphs.en: Standardized sensitivity: For condition c c at timestep t t , sensitivity is the mean loss difference ( L modified − L original L_{\mathrm{modified}}-L_{\mathrm{original}} ) divided by the sample SD ( n − 1 n-1 denominator) pooled over all items in the task at that timestep. Sharing this task-wide denominator preserves relative response magnitudes across conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 标准化敏感度：对于时间步 t t 中的条件 c c，敏感度是平均损失差异（ L modified − L original L_{\mathrm{modified}}-L_{\mathrm{original}} ）除以该时间步中任务内所有项目合并后的样本标准差（分母为 n − 1 n-1）。 共享整个任务的这一分母，可以保持不同条件下响应量级的相对关系。

sents.en: Standardized sensitivity: For condition c c at timestep t t , sensitivity is the mean loss difference ( L modified − L original L_{\mathrm{modified}}-L_{\mathrm{original}} ) divided by the sample SD ( n − 1 n-1 denominator) pooled over all items in the task at that timestep.
sents.zh: 标准化敏感度：对于时间步 t t 中的条件 c c，敏感度是平均损失差异（ L modified − L original L_{\mathrm{modified}}-L_{\mathrm{original}} ）除以该时间步中任务内所有项目合并后的样本标准差（分母为 n − 1 n-1）。

sents.en: Sharing this task-wide denominator preserves relative response magnitudes across conditions.
sents.zh: 共享整个任务的这一分母，可以保持不同条件下响应量级的相对关系。

paragraphs.en: Human alignment: Item-level Pearson correlation r r between model loss differences and human naturalness ratings, computed either pooled across the task or within each condition.
paragraphs.zh: 人类对齐：模型损失差异与人类自然度评分之间的项目级皮尔逊相关系数 r，该系数可基于整个任务计算，也可在每种条件下分别计算。

paragraphs.en: Peak locations: Peaks are defined as signed maxima on each model’s native discrete grid without smoothing or interpolation (exact ties break by the first stored index).
paragraphs.zh: 峰值位置：峰值被定义为每个模型原生离散网格上的带符号最大值，且未经平滑或插值处理（若出现完全相等的值，则以最先存储的索引为准）。

paragraphs.en: Thatcher task: Sensitivity peaked later than alignment in 20 of 25 models for upright faces (median shift Δ = + 0.184 \Delta=+0.184 ) and 18 of 25 for inverted faces (median Δ = + 0.192 \Delta=+0.192 ).

paragraphs.en: Illumination task: Sensitivity peaked later in 21 of 25 models for light direction ( Δ = + 0.204 \Delta=+0.204 ), 22 of 25 for reflection ( Δ = + 0.576 \Delta=+0.576 ), and 15 of 25 for cast shadow ( Δ = + 0.051 \Delta=+0.051 ).

paragraphs.en: These condition-level breakdowns show that sensitivity generally peaks later than alignment across visual manipulations. The magnitude of this shift varies across physical cues: it is largest for surface reflections and lighting direction, and smaller for cast shadows.
paragraphs.zh: 这些条件层面的分解结果表明，在各种视觉操控中，敏感度通常比一致性更晚达到峰值。 这种变化的幅度因物理线索而异：在表面反射和光照方向上最为显著，而在投射阴影中则较小。

paragraphs.en: To test whether our findings depend on empty text conditioning, we compared empty prompts with fixed descriptions of the stimulus content in a representative nine-model panel spanning diverse architectures (Stable Diffusion v1.5, SDXL, SD3, FLUX.1 dev, PixelGen, Qwen-Image, Wan2.1 T2V 1.3B, CogVideoX-2B, and LTX-Video 2B v0.9.0). Prompts described stimulus content (face orientation or a tabletop scene) without mentioning the visual manipulation or judging naturalness, and were identical for both the original and modified images within each pair (Table S7 ). Both prompt conditions were evaluated without classifier-free guidance, using the same timestep grids and noise draws (20 timesteps for image models, 10 for video models; five draws per timestep).
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验我们的研究结果是否依赖于空文本条件，我们将空提示与对刺激内容固定描述进行了比较，测试对象是一个包含多种架构的九模型代表性面板（Stable Diffusion v1.5、SDXL、SD3、FLUX.1 dev、PixelGen、Qwen-Image、Wan2.1 T2V 1.3B、CogVideoX-2B 和 LTX-Video 2B v0.9.0）。 提示描述了刺激内容（面部朝向或桌面场景），但未提及视觉操控或自然度判断，并且在每对图像中，原始图像和修改后图像的提示均完全相同（表 S7）。 两种提示条件均在无分类器引导的情况下进行评估，并使用了相同的时步网格和噪声采样（图像模型使用 20 个时步，视频模型使用 10 个时步；每个时步进行五次采样）。

sents.en: To test whether our findings depend on empty text conditioning, we compared empty prompts with fixed descriptions of the stimulus content in a representative nine-model panel spanning diverse architectures (Stable Diffusion v1.5, SDXL, SD3, FLUX.1 dev, PixelGen, Qwen-Image, Wan2.1 T2V 1.3B, CogVideoX-2B, and LTX-Video 2B v0.9.0).

paragraphs.en: Changes in human alignment (conditional minus empty Pearson r r ) ranged from − .034 -.034 to .014 .014 on Thatcher and from − .021 -.021 to .041 .041 on Illumination; Table S8 reports the paired estimates and 95% bootstrap confidence intervals for each model. Because the Thatcher prompts specified face orientation, we also assessed alignment within conditions: after removing orientation-specific means, correlations remained positive for all nine models under both prompt conditions. Across these nine models, human-alignment rankings had Spearman correlations of .967 .967 on Thatcher and .983 .983 on Illumination between prompt conditions. The sensitivity–alignment correlation changed from .659 .659 to .594 .594 on Thatcher and from .947 .947 to .954 .954 on Illumination. These results suggest that the observed differences in human alignment across models are largely preserved when simple descriptions of the stimulus content replace empty prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Thatcher 数据集上，人类对齐度（条件减去空值后的皮尔逊 r 值）的变化范围从 −0.034 到 0.014；在 Illumination 数据集上则从 −0.021 到 0.041；表 S8 报告了每个模型的配对估计值及 95% 的自助置信区间。 由于 Thatcher 提示指定了面部朝向，我们还评估了条件内的对齐度：在移除与朝向相关的均值后，两种提示条件下所有九个模型的相关性仍保持正值。 在这九个模型中，不同提示条件下的人类对齐度排名在 Thatcher 数据集上的斯皮尔曼相关性为 0.967，在 Illumination 数据集上为 0.983。 敏感性-对齐度相关性在 Thatcher 数据集上从 0.659 变为 0.594，在 Illumination 数据集上则从 0.947 变为 0.954。 这些结果表明，当用对刺激内容的简单描述替代空提示时，模型间观察到的人类对齐度差异基本得以保留。

paragraphs.en: Violation sensitivity and human alignment are both functions of the same estimated paired scores. Computing both metrics from the same finite noise draws can therefore introduce correlated sampling errors, potentially inflating their cross-model association. Testing this control requires individual per-draw losses. While all 16 image models preserved per-draw losses across 100 timesteps in the primary evaluation, the primary 50-timestep video evaluation did not retain per-draw outputs. We therefore sampled three representative video models (Wan2.1 T2V 1.3B, CogVideoX-2B, and LTX-Video 2B v0.9.0) from a separate 10-timestep evaluation where per-draw losses were recorded, forming a combined panel of 19 models. Both subsets retained 20 draws and all stimulus pairs (280 Thatcher and 288 Illumination).
paragraphs.zh: 违规敏感性与人类对齐性都是基于同一组估计配对得分的函数。 因此，从相同的有限噪声采样中计算这两种指标可能会引入相关的采样误差，从而可能夸大它们在不同模型间的关联程度。 要验证这一控制方法，需要获取每次采样的单独损失值。 尽管所有 16 个图像模型在主要评估的 100 个时间步中都保留了每次采样的损失值，但主要的 50 个时间步视频评估并未保留每次采样的输出结果。 因此，我们从一次独立的 10 个时间步评估中采样了三个具有代表性的视频模型（Wan2.1 T2V 1.3B、CogVideoX-2B 和 LTX-Video 2B v0.9.0），其中记录了每次采样的损失值，从而构成了一个包含 19 个模型的联合评估组。 这两个子集都保留了 20 次采样结果以及所有刺激对（280 个 Thatcher 刺激和 288 个 Illumination 刺激）。

The same-half estimate averages corr m ⁡ ( S A , r A ) \operatorname{corr}_{m}(S_{A},r_{A}) and corr m ⁡ ( S B , r B ) \operatorname{corr}_{m}(S_{B},r_{B}) ; the cross-half estimate averages corr m ⁡ ( S A , r B ) \operatorname{corr}_{m}(S_{A},r_{B}) and corr m ⁡ ( S B , r A ) \operatorname{corr}_{m}(S_{B},r_{A}) . As a result, the same-half and cross-half associations differed by less than .001 .001 in both tasks (Table S9 ), indicating that the relationship between violation sensitivity and human alignment is not driven by shared sampling noise.
